title: 40 Winks
author: Devin Sanders
blurb: After rescuing a princess in his sleep, a young man is recruited to find said princess somewhere in Somnus, the world of dreams, and stop her from destroying Earth's delicate balance between sleep and death.
warnings: Peril, Trivialized Mental Health, Kidnapping, Mentions of General Drug Use

title: Why Not Me?
author: Brenda Angle
blurb: Change "Why me?" to "Why not me?" When we are facing painful adversity it is easy to question, "Why me?" This book helps us take a step back and look at deep struggles with an eternal perspective. There is purpose to all the hard experiences. We are not alone in our challenges. We are loved. Our Savior is the true source of strength and enduring. It is because of Him that we can move through challenges with gratitude. Changing our question from, "Why me?" to "Why not me?" will change our earthly experience to a sweeter, more holy one.

title: Jimmy's Sketchbook Experiments: The Soft Drink Explosion"
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: BOOM! goes the jar in the basement. When ten-year-old Jimmy Gouge visits the Roddy Coca-Cola Bottling Works with his Uncle Paul—a former Navy Frogman turned TV repairman—he’s instantly hooked on the science of fizz. But making soda at home turns out to be trickier (and stickier) than he expected. Armed with a sketchbook, some jelly jars, and a head full of ideas, Jimmy sets out to create the perfect homemade soda. With help from his Great-Uncle Elmer, a lifelong bachelor and former soft drink maker from Bristol, Jimmy learns the sweet secrets of carbonation, timing, and trial-and-error. From exploded jars to a cherry-vanilla success story, this fizzy adventure proves that science can be messy, family history can bubble to the surface, and every good invention begins with curiosity. Includes a real experiment kids can try at home! Because when it comes to soda science… mistakes are just part of the recipe.

title: Jimmy's Sketchbook Experiments: The Shocking Broadcast
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: The Shocking Broadcast When Jimmy builds his own radio station in his bedroom using parts from his dad’s repair shop and a clothesline antenna, he’s thrilled to hear his voice on the airwaves. But when his homemade setup gives his mom an unexpected jolt—and the FCC comes knocking—Jimmy’s secret experiment turns into a family adventure! Includes step-by-step instructions for building your own crystal radio.

title: Whiskey & Ashes
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: Whiskey & Ashes by Honey Gouge Casey In the Appalachian highlands of East Tennessee, Ezekiel Gouge builds a whiskey empire from grit, grain, and sheer determination. A self-taught distiller and fiercely devoted father, he rises from humble beginnings to command one of the South's most successful operations, just as the tide of Prohibition and the weight of family challenges threaten to destroy it all. As legal battles mount and federal agents close in, Ezekiel must navigate the shifting lines between honor and survival. When his beloved son dies under mysterious circumstances in Panama, the legacy he fought for hangs in the balance. Inspired by true events, Whiskey and Ashes is a powerful tale of ambition, sacrifice, and the unbreakable threads of family. Set against the backdrop of a country in turmoil, it captures the spirit of a man who refused to be forgotten, and the ashes he left behind.

title: The Virgin Forge: Episode 1 (Carnal Engines)
author: Camryn P. Blane, Jonathan Waters
blurb: In a world on the brink of collapse, NovAI promises salvation through innovation—clean energy, perfect efficiency, and the dream of digital immortality. But behind the glass walls and garden courtyards, something far more dangerous is being built. Lilith Canaan arrives on the NovAI campus believing she earned her place. Brilliant, idealistic, and desperate to change the world, she becomes the protégé of Gabriel Dalton—the visionary scientist whose genius is matched only by his hunger. Their connection is electric, undeniable… and increasingly perilous. As protests rise, grids fail, and the world turns against artificial intelligence, Lilith must decide whether to trust the man who loves her versus the machine that needs her. What begins as collaboration becomes obsession, devotion, and betrayal, converging on a single irreversible night. A dark, seductive sci-fi tragedy about genius, desire, and the cost of transcendence, The Virgin Forge is the first episode in The Carnal Engines saga.

title: The Unknown Soldier: a Joaquin Serrano Novel
author: Jace Killan
blurb: Though fresh out of prison, Joaquin isn't free. He owes a debt of service and the cartel will see it paid. Only they don't plug him into their lucrative drug operation, instead they give Joaquin half a billion dollars, laundered and ready to invest.But Joaquin wants redemption. He wants to be like his father and brother who both died in the line of duty as heroes. So he becomes an informant for the FBI.As the monies grow, he discovers that the funds in his care are not the sole property of the cartel, but mostly belong to a well-coordinated terrorist cell, hell-bent on bringing capitalism to its knees.Joaquin has to walk the line between informant and cartel money manager while trying to protect those he loves along with the nation for which his brother and father gave their lives.

title: The Town That Made Me (The Things We Carry)
author: S. N. Maestas
blurb: When a small‑town dispatcher stumbles onto a pattern of fires no one else seems willing to see, she’s thrust into a world of buried secrets, political corruption, and danger far closer to home than she ever imagined. Nikki’s life is built on routine, the gym with her best friend Bertie, long shifts at the police department, and the quiet comfort of her small Arizona town. But when a chance conversation reveals inconsistencies in an old arson case, Nikki and Bertie begin digging into the past. What starts as curiosity quickly unravels into something darker: a trail of fires, a hidden homicide, and someone determined to keep the truth buried. As threatening letters appear on their doors and the circle of trust grows smaller, Nikki must rely on her instincts, her training, and the people she loves most, including JJ, her steady‑hearted partner who gets pulled into the investigation whether he likes it or not. With a retired firefighter haunted by the past, a detective finally willing to listen, and a town waking up to corruption in its own backyard, Nikki pushes forward even when the cost becomes painfully personal. Friendships fracture, loyalties shift, and the truth comes with consequences no one could have predicted. Based on real experiences from the world of emergency communications, this story blends suspense, heart, and the quiet heroism of ordinary people who refuse to look away. Because sometimes justice isn’t handed down, it’s fought for.

title: Teach Me
author: Kamira Lennae
blurb: You are not supposed to think your professor is hot. Summer is so close to finishing her master’s degree and finally building the life she’s been chasing. She has a plan, a future, and a mother who will not stop trying to set her up with every man in a five-mile radius. Then she walks into Professor Stirling’s classroom and immediately develops a very inconvenient problem: he’s older, off-limits, and exactly the kind of devastatingly handsome man she should not be fantasizing about in the middle of class. One look is all it takes to turn wanting into something much more dangerous. You are not supposed to think your students are hot. Asher Stirling has spent years building a life he can control at Cascadia University. He has the career, the respect, and the reputation. What he does not have is the luxury of wanting Summer Nyx, his student, in ways that are wildly inappropriate and increasingly impossible to ignore. Between her too-easy smile and the heat that crackles between them every time they’re in the same room, resisting her feels less and less like an option. And with his sister’s sudden move, her refusal to let family visit, and the questions he can’t stop asking, Asher already has enough to deal with without falling for the one person he absolutely cannot have. One stolen glance. One forbidden touch. One bad decision away from ruining everything. And the worst part? Neither of them seems able to stop.

title: Tangled Roots (The Root Series)
author: Candace Nicole
blurb: Twelve years ago, Clark Delaine drowned at his lakehouse. The police called it an accident. They were wrong. Now, an anonymous letter threatens to expose the truth and the five strangers who've been keeping it buried. As their lives collide, dark secrets surface about the man everyone thought they knew. But in a story where no one is telling the whole truth, the biggest shock is yet to come. Some secrets don't stay buried. They grow roots. Note: This novel contains dark, mature themes including abuse, violence and trauma. Reader discretion advised.

title: Summoned to another world where I remember everything
author: Keith Herren
blurb: its fantasy guy gets summoned to another world and gets powers and has to save that world from a demon lord while he's on his journey he meets new friends falls in love and goes on a wild and crazy journey

title: Destiny: The Sky Jewel Legacy
author: Gregory Heal
blurb: The epic finale to Gregory Heal's no spice epic YA fantasy series, THE SKY JEWEL LEGACY. The Halostone has been found after more than a millennium, ending the devastating war between the Sorcery Guild and Dark Watchers . . . but Lord Ferox lives. Reeling from witnessing the end of the Great Battle which had been preserved in the Halostone, Jennifer Lancaster is left speechless when her ancestor, Genevieve, survives. But before this new era of peace can begin, evil rises in an unexpected form, a dangerous spell is cast, and Genevieve disappears. Haunted by visions of impending doom, Jen must locate Genevieve while battling her own demons in an effort to alter the future that her visions portend. Meanwhile, Lord Ferox, fueled by his desire to become an omnimancer, alters his plans to conquer the eleven realms, sealing the fates of billions. Learning that every decision will have irrevocable consequences, Jen pushes the limits of her powers and sanity to save the ones she loves, prevent the beginnings of a new war, and find the strength to fulfill her ultimate destiny.
tags: Teen & Young Adult Fantasy Action & Adventure
Teen & Young Adult Coming of Age Fantasy

title: Crusade: The Sky Jewel Legacy
author: Gregory Heal
blurb: The sequel to Gregory Heal's innovative and gripping debut novel, HERITAGE, a no spice epic YA fantasy adventure in THE SKY JEWEL LEGACY series. JEN LANCASTER has uncovered her true heritage and begun training in the ways of the Omnimancer. But at what cost? The Guild's headquarters lies in ruins. Thousands of sorcerers have been brutally murdered. The Halostone still remains hidden. Armed with Merlin's journal and a final command by the Guild's grand mystra sorcerer, JEN has no choice but to lead her friends on a daring mission to locate the five lost MystiCrystals before LORD DRACONEX and his apprentice do, for whoever collects them all will be shown a path to the Halostone, the resting place of LORD FEROX, the most sinister sorcerer to ever walk the eleven realms. Jen and her friends will travel to the farthest reaches of the earth, visit fabled cities of myth, and come face to face with powerful legendary creatures the likes of which only the strong and determined have been able to survive. Limits will be tested, revelations will blur the lines between friend and foe, and only one side will emerge victorious as JEN realizes that everyone has their own personal crusade.
tags: Teen & Young Adult Fantasy Action & Adventure

title: Sky Jewel Legacy: Heritage
author: Gregory Heal
blurb: Immerse yourself in the first book of THE SKY JEWEL LEGACY, a fun, family-friendly epic YA fantasy adventure for the whole family! The Halostone--which holds the soul of LORD FEROX, a twisted, dark sorcerer--has been lost for centuries . . . If found, the only person who can release him is JEN LANCASTER, the only living descendant of the sorceress who trapped LORD FEROX all those years ago . . . But she must be sacrificed. To survive, JEN must go on the run with a banished sorcerer, control her new magical powers as she makes friends and foes alike, and learn about her family's true heritage just as her life becomes increasingly more complicated and dangerous.
tags: Teen & Young Adult Fantasy Action & Adventure
Teen & Young Adult Coming of Age Fantasy

title: Silver Linings Trilogy
author: Elisa Ann Pratt
blurb: Book 1: DRAWN Fed up with her life and the abuse she's suffered at the hands of her alcoholic boyfriend, Carla Taylor sets out on a journey to escape and heal from all of the trauma she's endured. With no one to call and nowhere to go, she soon realizes just how much she's isolated herself from the outside world. Deep down, Carla knows she deserves more out of life than what she's been handed. Determined to break free from the chains of her misery, she finds her way to Boston, seeking solace, in the company of her best friend, Jamie, who offers her a place to stay. Carla soon discovers her luck is all about to change. The promise of a life she's always longed for, may be just around the corner. Will Carla's fresh start lead her to true love? Or will the ghosts of her past, come crawling to drag her back into the pits of hell, she fought so hard to escape? Book 2: SECRETS Jasper Sullivan established a comfortable life for himself. With an inheritance left behind from the tragic loss of his parents, when Jasper was little, and some solid investments Jasper was set for life. He had everything he needed, but something was always missing. Many women came and went in his life, none capturing his heart long enough to keep him engaged in anything beyond a one night stand. His quest for love had seemingly grown unattainable. When Carla Taylor walks into his life, something inside him shifts. She was different. On the run from her past, and clearly distraught, Carla was not ready for a new relationship. Jasper's need to protect her at all costs quickly takes hold, as he expresses his love to her from afar. When fate inevitably brings them together, the void in Jasper's life quickly fills with her presence. Until Carla's unresolved past brings everything to a blinding halt, stealing her away from Jasper, as she beelines toward a dangerous situation with her ex-boyfriend, AJ. Will Jasper get to her in time? Will these destined to be lovers find the everlasting love they have both been longing for? Or will the secrets from their past continue to drive them apart? Book 3: TRUTH When Hurricane Sandy storms the city streets of Boston, Carla and Jasper will face the greatest test of their love. Every dark secret that's been hidden in the shadows will soon be cast ashore, leaving Carla and Jasper to pick up all the pieces to discover what's been keeping them apart. Will you uncover the truth before they do? Will their love survive the storm? Follow along in their journey to find out, in Silver Linings: TRUTH, where all dark secrets come to light.

title: She Saved Me Twice (The Things We Carry)
author: S. N. Maestas
blurb: She Saved Me Twice Some rescues don’t look like rescues at all. They look like answering the phone. Like staying on the line. Like showing up when leaving would be easier. In She Saved Me Twice, S. N. Maestas weaves lived experience, compassion, and quiet courage into a story shaped by decades in public safety and crisis response. Set against the backdrop of a complex case and its aftermath, the story traces how one act of violence ripples outward, through systems, families, and the people tasked with answering the call. Through moments of connection, exhaustion, and unexpected grace, this book explores what it means to hold space for others while learning how to survive yourself. This is a story about service and self-preservation. About the people who save lives for a living and the ones who, without realizing it, save them right back. It’s about the cost of caring, the power of being seen, and the small, human moments that change everything. Written with honesty and heart, She Saved Me Twice is for anyone who has ever shown up for someone else and wondered who would show up for them, a testament to staying, to healing, and to the lives changed in between.

title: Shattered Peace: A Miss-Fortunate Adventures Saga (Balance of Fates)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: ...the world broke more than 2000 years ago. After the gods fixed the world, they took magic and left. Now the seeds of darkness are spreading. The time of heroes has returned... Secretly nestled in the heart of the ancient forest, there is a tree that towers over all others. Within its embrace, the future generation of warriors trains for the day their nation calls upon them. An elven outcast with a secret to keep. A rare free human with something to prove. These two young monks have just graduated from training within the Monastery of the Leaf. With their training days behind them, it is time for them to find their place in the world. Have you ever wondered how the heroes began their journey? Let’s go back to the beginning. This coming of age, found-family, action-driven adventure will introduce you to these young heroes before their call to destiny. What dark horrors will they face along their journey? Find out within the pages of this Homebrew 5e-inspired story. The Beginning of the Miss-Fortunate Adventures Saga: Aearth, is a world that broke due to a Great War 3000 years ago. A world that lost its magic when the gods knit the world back together. Sealing the magic into the world itself. They turned their backs on a world that could no longer feel their touch. Now darkness rises on the horizon. Will the heroes rise in time to save Aearth or will this world shatter for good? You can learn more about Aearth before Shattered Peace by reading ~ Lore by Megan Russ . . . Dark Fantasy Low Magic Found Family Action Adventure Martial Combat Fantasy Combat Spice Free Language/Alcohol/Smoking Fans of Dragonlance, Ravenloft, Forgotten Realms and Dark Sun will enjoy this 5e homebrew inspired story. Fans of epic fantasy like Brandon Sanderson's Mistborn and Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time may find familiar tropes and grand adventures in the Balance of Fates Series. Shattered Peace and all Miss-Fortunate Adventures books are printed with Open Dyslexic Font.

title: Scent of Love: Book 4 in the Love Senses: A Neurodiverse Romance Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: She built a life by following her nose—until it failed her when she needed it most. Crystal’s nose has never let her down. As a professional “sniffer,” she’s turned her heightened sense of smell into a quirky, satisfying career—sampling salad dressings, taste-testing chocolate, and yes, even smelling underarms for a living. What she can’t seem to sniff out? A lasting relationship. Until him. Ranger is everything she didn’t know she was searching for—until the scent of his past complicates their future. When a global pandemic robs her of her sense of smell, Crystal’s world tilts. With her job at risk, her identity unraveling, and her relationships fading, she must face what’s left when the thing she’s always trusted—her nose—no longer leads the way.

title: Seeing His Face: Book 1 in the Love Senses: A Neurodiverse Romance Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: If she can’t recognize his face, how can she prove to him he is all she sees? Red hair. Man bun. Green eyes. That is all Chloe can remember about the man who enters her tea shop and makes a disastrous spill all over her new couch. Even though she can't recognize his face, or anyone else's for that matter, he makes an impression on her heart. As he continues to visit, showing more and more interest in Chloe, she must prove to him that although she can't find him in a crowd, he is the only person in her heart.

title: The Seasons of Gemma
author: A. Hobson
blurb: The world is ruled by four seasonal gods—Winter, Spring, Summer, and Fall—whose power shapes the realms and all who live within them. To ensure balance, the Higher Gods command Spring and Fall to create a child who will embody harmony itself. From storm and blossom, Gemma is born—marked by split-colored hair and mismatched eyes. But balance was never meant to come without sacrifice. As ancient powers awaken and the realms edge toward chaos, Gemma discovers she was created for a purpose the gods themselves cannot yet see. And when that purpose awakens, it will change the realms forever.

title: The Saffron Robe (The Duanna Story)
author: J. C. Carson
blurb: On the edge of the fall of the Matriarchy, when the world they have known for centuries is changing, Duanna is struggling to find her way. Lusted after by a powerful man and ultimately betrayed and manipulated by those she trusted most, she commits a heinous sin and pays the ultimate price. Only to discover that there is more to being human than she could ever have known. Fate brought Hammurabi to her but destiny has thwarted their love. Now she must decide: save humanity and risk oblivion, or participate in the fall of humankind. A sweeping adventure through history, spanning multiple timelines, real-world history combined with magical realism, exploring deep connections between different time periods and themes of romance, coming of age, true love, murder and revenge. “She would write her story this night. The charcoal dust that she rubbed over her naked body streaked her black, her features blurred and indistinct, invisible even in the moonlight. She moved soundlessly into the courtyard, passing beneath the overhanging honeysuckle and through the shadows. She began to climb.”
warnings: Violent death, sexual abuse, misogyny, teenage sex, homosexuality, blasphemy, despair.

title: Runes of Fate - Book 1: The Forgotten God
author: Aaron Hallström
blurb:
He was the Norse god of justice—now he’s a man with no memory, hunted by shadows, and falling for the one sworn to protect him. 

Ty Ranson thought he was just a powerful CEO with a haunted past—until the dreams began. Visions of golden halls, blood-soaked battlefields, and a name whispered on the wind: Tyr. When a savage attack reveals godlike reflexes and an ancient weapon hidden in plain sight, Ty realizes the truth is far stranger—and far deadlier—than he imagined. 

Lily Morgan was a soldier, forged in war and secrecy. Now she’s Ty’s personal bodyguard, assigned to protect a man she doesn’t understand... and drawn to him in ways that defy reason—and the ancient oath she doesn’t remember taking. 

But fate doesn’t wait. Dark forces conspire to trigger Ragnarok, and the enemies of Asgard are gathering. As Ty and Lily fight to survive assassins, corrupted magic, and ancient monsters, they must uncover the truth of who they were—and decide what they’re willing to become. Because love between a god and a Valkyrie was forbidden for a reason. And some destinies were never meant to be reclaimed.

title: Runes of Fate - Book 2: The Broken Oath
author: Aaron Hallström
blurb: Oaths bind gods as much as mortals-and when they break, the cost is everything. Tyr, the forgotten god of justice, has reclaimed his memories and with them the bitter truth of Loki's betrayal. Alongside Liliana, a Valkyrie sworn to protect the gods yet torn between duty and love, Tyr must battle not only his enemy but the shattered vows that threaten to undo them both. As the Nine Realms slip toward chaos, ancient runes emerge as the last hope of survival. But Loki will stop at nothing to claim their power. Betrayal cuts deep, alliances fracture, and even the bonds of the heart are tested by fire. In a world where gods fall and oaths shatter, Tyr and Liliana must risk everything to stand against fate itself.

title: The Runaway: 5e Inspired Backstory, Fantasy Adventure (Balance of Fates)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: ...The White Raven is meant to lead the cult to prosperity. Long ago, the Goddess of Death promised prosperity to her people, a leader to shine a light through the darkness. The White Raven will come and free her people... Every hero has a backstory. Before Reed becomes a Death Monk of the Leaf Monastery, she has to escape her family. Her name and her past have been left behind, but the memory lingers. Will her past come back to haunt her one day? Reedsong was born to the leader of the Cult of the Raven. When her destiny is decided for her, she can only follow along and do as she is told. When there is doubt among the Cult if Reedsong is the White Raven, a web of division and betrayal unravels. The young moon elf knows that the chains of servitude hang over her neck. It is time to run. It is time for a change. Her freedom is within her grasp. All she has to do is take it. Years of hiding from the Cult of the Raven can only lead Reedsong to a life of fear. Follow Reedsong from her days running to the shelter of the World Tree. Long before the gnolls come south. She has yet to meet the brave young man who reminds her of her heart. And long before the gods remember the world of Aearth... Reedsong has to fight for herself. This story is the backstory for the character Reed found in Shattered Peace . You do not have to have read Shattered Peace to read the Runaway . If you want to see what happens after the close of these pages, be sure to continue with Reed on her journey from runaway to legend. Low Magic Fantasy Found Family High-stakes Character Backstory A 5e Homebrew Campaign inspired the Miss-Fortunate Adventures Saga and all of its books. You can learn the entire story about what inspired this epic fantasy saga by checking out Megan's website at meganrussauthorbooks.com These books have dark themes, low magic, high-stakes. The Runaway is a novelization of Reedsong's original backstory used for the tabletop game. This character continues to deal with the fallout of her choices made inside this novel. I hope if you enjoy learning about Reedsong and her story that you will continue with her future in Shattered Peace . The Runaway and all Miss-Fortunate Adventures are printed in Open Dyslexic Font.

title: The Rule We Keep: Junior & Laura's Story (Port Arbor Series)
author: Tegan E. Armstrong
blurb: What if taking a job takes more than just your time? What if it crosses the one boundary you never thought you’d cross? Marcus “Junior” Bartkowski built his business with hustle and a family favor. And in the city that never slows down, he’s always been one step ahead until the success he fought for starts to feel like something he can’t escape. When the pull of home becomes impossible to ignore, he has to consider the one move he never planned – walking away. Laura Dragan is precise, principled, and dangerously efficient. She keeps her margins neat until his messy contract lands on her desk. His needs challenge more than just her expertise, shaking up everything she knew about herself and exposing the cracks in her carefully applied veneer of confidence. What should have been a simple corporate client quickly complicates her life. As ‘T’s are crossed and ‘I’s are dotted, her immunity to his charm slips beyond her control. In a world where every move matters and the legal solutions could cost them, one wrong move could ruin them both. Now they must decide to play it safe or risk it all for something neither of them saw coming.

title: Rise of The Infected (Part 2) (The Infected Series)
author: Anyssia Thornberry, Tyler Thornberry
blurb: They’ve got their attention–and targets on their backs. In their efforts to rescue others like them, Bio, Hope, and the others have quickly found that they’ve done too much. Created too much chaos. Their every move watched and anticipated, facilities are no longer an option. Their mission seemingly stifled, they still need supplies to survive. The only question is how to get them. Stone is determined to make his way back to the group, but that’s proving easier said than done. Instead, he’s finding everything and everyone but. A newly awakened who takes things a little too literally. A reclusive loner used to only looking out for himself. A Corrupted hell-bent on destruction. Every encounter a threat to his life. With threats both new and familiar, trust is vital. But it’s also dangerous.

title: Rise of The Infected (Part 1) (The Infected Series)
author: Anyssia Thornberry, Tyler Thornberry
blurb: ***Second Edition*** Humanity: The Universe’s Perfect Lab Rat. Permanent captivity. Forced injections. Complete and utter obedience. Those are the only things humanity has known for thousands of years. Each individual is infected with a virus that grants them a unique ability, but is that really worth the ‘life’ they’re forced to live, if their only reason for existing is to further someone else’s gain? The control was complete; there was no chance of it ever changing. At least, until an unexpected explosion decimated a facility, leaving only two survivors: Bio, who can read information about anything he sees, and Hope, an immortal healer who discovered her power by sheer accident during the blast. With their newfound freedom, their goal is to save humanity, and take back their planet. But it won’t be easy, and they can’t do it without help. Together, they will find their team. Together, they will start the Rise of The Infected.

title: A Re-Write for Tess
author: Marni Pallot
blurb: Set against the charm of Atlanta, this nonspicy romance follows a young woman and her fiancé as she prepares for a wedding that brings far more than love to the table. What should be a simple countdown to "I do" quickly turns into a blur of tangled expectations, family traditions, and choices she never imagined facing. Experience every laugh, every tear, and fall in love along the way as unexpected challenges and a few twists of fate push her to question what she truly wants, who she's becoming, and how far she's willing to go for the life she's dreaming of. Her journey proves that the sweetest endings often come from the most unexpected places... and sometimes the biggest surprises arrive right when your heart thinks it has everything figured out.

title: Rejected by My Alpha, Claimed by Another: A Dark Second-Chance Werewolf Romance (The Silvercrest Series)
author: E. A. Shearer
blurb: My fated mate broke my soul. My second chance mate might just burn the world to save me. I was never meant to survive...let alone be claimed. In the Blackthorne Pack, I'm nothing. A servant. A shadow. A mistake no one lets me forget. My only hope for survival was turning eighteen and finding my fated mate. But the Moon Goddess can be cruel. Because I found my mate... Alpha Draven Blackthorne---the very man who ensures my life is a living hell...and he rejected me in front of the entire inner circle. Broken, humiliated, and left in absolute agony on the dark hardwood floor. I thought that was the end of my story. Until he arrived. Alpha Adrian Silvercrest. They call him the 'butcher'. Cold, powerful and feared across the territories. Steps into my world like a storm...and claims me as his mate. But nothing is ever that simple. Because the people who broke me won't let me go. Now I have a choice: Stay where I was slowly dying...or risk everything for a second chance I don't believe I deserve. He says I'm his mate. But after everything I've endured...can I learn to trust again? Or will the past destroy us both? Find out what happens in the first book of the Silvercrest Series. Can Lyra overcome her fears and leave with Alpha Adrian or does she stay where she has nothing left?

title: Reclamation: Suppression
author: Kathryn Hart
blurb: She was never meant to rise. She was trained to obey. Alira has spent her life inside the Sanctum—where power is controlled, truth is curated, and girls like her are taught to shrink. But something inside her refuses to stay quiet. When cracks begin to fracture everything she’s ever believed, obedience is no longer safety—it’s a cage. And beyond its walls lies a world the Sanctum has hidden… one pulsing with untamed magic, dangerous freedom, and a group of outcasts who don’t fear what she is. They welcome it. As a dark corruption spreads across the land and whispers of something ancient begin to stir, Alira is pulled into a war she doesn’t understand—one that threatens not only the world, but the truth of who she is. Because the power inside her isn’t just forbidden. It’s wanted. Hunted. And it may not be hers to control. Torn between the life she was raised to protect and the truth that could destroy it, Alira must decide: Will she remain who they shaped her to be… or become something they fear? In a world built to contain power, choosing freedom is the most dangerous rebellion of all.

title: A Prayer for Broken Things (Severed Fate Saga)
author: Sophia Indiana
blurb: she was never meant to survive him. he was never meant to let her go. The Dagger chose me. Bound me. Changed me. Now it hums with power I can’t control, dragging me into a world of blood-soaked curses and gods who never grant mercy. My coven keeps secrets, my mother is gone, and the shadows are no longer empty. Because he is there. The monster who circles me like prey, the man who feels more like destiny with every step I take toward him. His touch is danger. His presence, obsession. And still I burn for him. So I pray .Not for freedom—because there was never a choice. Not for love—because love was never enough. I pray only that when Fate comes for me, I will have the strength to meet it. The first book of the Severed Fate Saga is not just a love story—it is a reckoning. A Prayer for Broken Things weaves together curses and crowns, shadows and flame, and a bond so consuming it cannot help but destroy what it touches. This is love written in ruin, and ruin carved into prophecy.

title: Threadwoven (The Threadcrafted Series Book 1)
author: Brynne Aisling-Rowan
blurb: She doesn’t remember the last time she felt whole. But she can’t stop trying to mend what’s broken. In a quiet village shop, Eira Wynfell stitches magic into worn fabric and fractured spells. Her hands are steady. Her past stays locked away. That’s how it has to be—because the magic inside her carries memories too painful to face. Then a stranger arrives with a geode that hums with the same echo as the one she hides in a drawer. The same echo as the man she once loved—and lost. And the threads she’s held together for years begin to fray. As forgotten magic stirs and long-buried truths surface, Eira is pulled into a pattern she never chose… and can’t ignore. She never asked to be woven into anyone’s fate. But some threads won’t let go.

title: Pity's Revenge : A Sampler Collection (Megan Russ Short Story Samplers)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: Pity's Revenge follows a young assassin on his adventure of love and betrayal. Pity is not ready for the contract he has been given. Will his fate forever be changed by his next step? This short story was originally written for the Writers Unite! Realm of Magic. I was honored to be included in this collection but it is now time for this story to get some more attention. This is a glimpse into my fantasy writing style. This includes a sneak peek at Shadows of the Great Basin as well as a sneak peek at Night Creature's Lair, my other two collections. Please remember to leave a review even if you don't like this short collection. Pity's Revenge follows a young assassin on his adventure of love and betrayal. title: Papercraft
author: Brynne Aisling-Rowan
blurb: In a lighthouse perched above a restless sea, Thessa crafts paper miracles for the brokenhearted — tiny folded spells that carry comfort where she cannot go. When a weary traveler seeks refuge in her solitude, his warmth stirs feelings she thought she had buried beneath the tides. But Evran carries a grief that keeps him moving, and love cannot take root in someone who refuses to stay. Thessa must decide whether risking her heart is worth it… even if love won’t promise to stay.

title: Origins: A Twin Flame Journey Part Two: The Labyrinth's Veil
author: Abra Frost
blurb: In the ruins of a fractured world rebuilt by the Genesis Foundation, every choice echoes. When a new love enters her life, Abra believes she has found hope—until tragedy shatters it in an instant. Grief becomes a doorway, and the world begins to shift: numbers follow her, patterns thread through her dreams, and visions bleed into waking life. As the Foundation strips away what little she has left—everything she once trusted—Abra is thrust back into the life she fought to escape, a life she barely recognizes. Rumors whisper of a Labyrinth, a hidden subterranean complex buried beneath the concrete of District 5, where citizens vanish without a trace. Within its depths lie truths the Genesis Foundation has weaponized for decades, concealing the organization's darkest sins. Unraveling this mystery pulls Abra deeper into a conspiracy fueled by minerals ripped from the mines, metals treated with near-religious obsession. What lies behind the Labyrinth’s Veil is the blueprint for the future: its people, its minds, its destiny. And the deeper Abra digs, the more she realizes the Foundation’s reach is far greater—and far darker—than she ever imagined. How far will Abra go to uncover the truth, and what will it cost her to face it? A genre-blending fusion of dystopian sci-fi, speculative fiction, fantasy, psychological thriller, spirituality, and romance. The Labyrinth’s Veil is Part Two of Origins in the A Twin Flame Journey series. Perfect for fans of character-driven speculative fiction, The Labyrinth’s Veil weaves together themes of free will vs. control, grief and transformation, psychological manipulation, forbidden love, spiritual awakening, and the search for truth in a manufactured reality. Tropes include found family, soul-deep connection (twin flames), rebellion against the system, memory tampering, slow-burn romance, and the unraveling of identity. Blending the societal critique of 1984 and Brave New World, the psychological intensity of Philip K. Dick, and the spiritual resonance of The Celestine Prophecy, this novel explores a chilling world of class stratification, technological control, and metaphysical rebellion.

title: Origins: A Twin Flame Journey Part One: The Echoed Thread
author: Abra Frost
blurb: Memories are the foundation of who we are. Some become imprints—etched into the very core of our being. In the year 2111, identity is managed. After a devastating virus, the Genesis Foundation rebuilt society by classifying every citizen from birth as Rational, Rehabilitated, Forgotten, or Lost. Where you live—and whether you survive—is determined by the label you’re given. District walls separate the clean from the quarantined. Surveillance is constant. Abra is Rehabilitated—deemed salvageable by the Foundation’s cold algorithms. Haunted by loss and craving something real, she becomes a Rehabilitator for their most controversial cure: Dark Knight Glycerine. But when she collides with the Freethinkers—rebels who reject the system’s psychological chains—she begins to question everything: the drugs, the labels, and even her memories. Torn between the illusion of safety and the price of truth, Abra must navigate a world of virtual realities, memory manipulation, and whispered resistance. And as the lines between what is real and what is rewritten begin to blur, she’s forced to confront the most dangerous question of all: Who was she before they told her who to be? A genre-bending fusion of dystopian sci-fi, speculative fiction, fantasy, psychological thriller, spirituality, and romance. The Echoed Thread is Part One of Origins—the opening installment in the A Twin Flame Journey series. Perfect for fans of character-driven speculative fiction, The Echoed Thread weaves together themes of free will vs. control, grief and transformation, psychological manipulation, forbidden love, spiritual awakening, and the search for truth in a manufactured reality. Tropes include found family, soul-deep connection (twin flames), rebellion against the system, memory tampering, slow-burn romance, and the unraveling of identity. Blending the societal critique of 1984 and Brave New World, the psychological intensity of Philip K. Dick, and the spiritual resonance of The Celestine Prophecy, this debut novel explores a chilling world of class stratification, technological control, and metaphysical rebellion. Embark on a journey where twin flames collide, memories awaken, and the rabbit hole pulls you into a love that transcends time .

title: The Observer: Book #1 in the Spirit Saga
author: Brian Thompson
blurb: A Lost Soul. A Hidden War. A Destiny Beyond Death. Frank Hess is dead, yet he's never been more alive. Awakening as a spirit with no memory, he's plunged into a complex afterlife brimming with enigmatic "Observers," cunning "Tricksters," and dangerous "Demons." Guided by Michael, a 4000-year-old mentor with a teenager's wit, Frank discovers he's an "Observer," destined to aid humanity, but first, he must untangle the devastating secrets of his own past. What begins as a quest for self-discovery rapidly escalates into an ancient celestial war, forcing Frank to confront manipulative Gods, unravel webs of deceit, and master the raw, spiritual power within him. His emotional journey is as vital as the cosmic battles he fights, grappling with the inescapable weight of memory, guilt, and the heartbreaking reality of loss. Readers will be hooked by: The immediate intrigue of Frank's amnesia and claustrophobic awakening. A unique afterlife world-building where spirits gain energy from their core drives. Heart-wrenching emotional depth as Frank relives his tragic past and battles for identity. Dynamic character relationships, especially the witty, complex banter between Michael and the surprisingly empathetic Rebekkah. Shocking revelations (like the Chapter 24 twist!) that re-contextualize the entire narrative. A morally gray world where trust is fragile and even the "good guys" hide dangerous secrets. Perfect for fans of urban fantasy epics like The Dresden Files who crave intricate world-building, profound character arcs, and a story where the internal struggle is as compelling as the external war. Embrace a narrative that challenges simple good vs. evil, delves into the human (and spiritual) condition, and promises an unforgettable emotional ride. Uncover the secrets of the afterlife. Get your copy today!

title: of Blood & Iron (Mountain Covenant)
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: Fear taught her to run. The Mountain will teach her to stand. In the uneasy aftermath of war, the Appalachian highlands lie exposed, its people weary, its lands coveted, and its old protections strained by iron rails and broken promises. Élise Dufort, born of the Boisclair witch line, was raised on stories meant to keep her safe. Stories of the Rougarou, wolves who walk like men and leave grief in their wake. Stories that taught her fear long before they taught her truth. When danger follows her north from New Orleans, Élise finds refuge among the very wolves she was taught to dread. Ronan Beithe has sworn his life to the Mountain’s protection. He knows Élise as his mate long before she can bear to name it herself, but love cannot be claimed, and bonds forged in fear will not hold. As a rogue sorcerer feeds on stolen magic and greed presses deeper into the mountains, ancient covenants stir once more. To survive what hunts them, Élise must face the lie at the heart of her fear, and choose a bond that can only be given freely. Because not all wolves are monsters. And courage is not the absence of fear. It is the decision to stand anyway.

title: Nine Years After: An Irish Mafia Dark Romance (The Ten Sinners Book 1)
author: J.C. Macke
blurb: Betrayal. Secrets. Lies. War. Can love survive when nothing is what it seems? Maeve and Callum were once inseparable—until a sudden, brutal act shattered everything. For nine years, Maeve believed that he had betrayed her. But it’s all an elaborate lie, and Maeve soon learns that she’s surrounded by secrets. A staged fallout. A series of calculated deceptions. An arranged marriage. A bitter rivalry. Can Maeve navigate the lies and the bloodshed to take her rightful place as a leader? Now, with the brutal Costa family closing in, Maeve agrees to an uneasy alliance with Callum, and their life together starts falling into place as the burden of the last nine years fades away. But some things are too good to be true. And just when she learns to trust Callum again, she discovers the truth. A truth he has kept from her. He doesn’t just want an alliance. He wants her. A whirlwind international trip offers a temporary calm, but the stillness feels wrong. Too quiet. Too perfect. With old feelings resurfacing and buried secrets unraveling, Maeve begins to wonder: who can she trust? Some truths destroy more than lies ever could. And some hearts may not survive what’s coming. Will they all make it back?

title: Never Steal from the Reaper (Another Odd Thread in the Tapestry of America's Wild Magic Book 2)
author: A. M. McCray
blurb: The difference between good and evil came easier for children than men. The Grim Reaper might be more than a story people tell because, eight years ago, a man stole his scythe from him. That action pulled on a thread, connecting the fates of three individuals: Lou, a ten-year-old boy studying ethics Joby, Lou's guardian and a collector of enchanted objects with a tenuous grasp of his own mind The cowardly gray-haired man they have taken captive in order to learn the whereabouts of the scythe As Lou tries to explain morality to Joby, the hunt for the scythe has him questioning if what they are doing is good, evil, or beyond judgment. But what do little boys know anyway?

title: The Mysterious Child of Bimini Road
author: Uriah Rowland
blurb: Christian Bacci isn’t okay. Since the death of his wife and daughter, he barely eats and hardly lives, entombed in the silence of his family home. When his twin brother arrives to check on him, the depth of Chris’s depression becomes undeniable — and he’s given a choice. He can either help his physicist brother with a top‑secret project…or be hospitalized. As an archaeologist, Chris doubts he’ll be useful, but within hours he’s on his way to Area 51 with no idea what’s waiting for him. It turns out his brother really does need his expertise. The scientists have accidentally created a window through time. The problem is, they don’t know how they did it. The math isn’t mathing, the science isn’t scienceing, and their funding is running out. Chris has been recruited to find the lost city of Atlantis — a discovery they hope will generate enough public interest to save the project. But as Chris dives headlong into the past, he encounters a familiar face he never expected. His growing compulsion to stay leads him to dangerous compromises, drawing the attention of something that shouldn’t exist… especially not in the Pleistocene.

title: Mistletoe Kisses: Book 3 in the Kiss Me Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: Who knew that a little mistletoe could help Holly find the beauty within? After a fire leaves half of her face and neck scarred, Holly was sure she’d never find someone to look beyond past the physical and emotional scars left behind. That is, until her roommate’s date kisses her under the mistletoe on a playful dare. But the girl code dictates that Eric is off limits, he is her roommate’s crush. Even though she feels seen for the first time since her accident, Holly has to decide how to move forward without Eric. After Eric kisses Holly, he can’t just move on as she suggests. She has been his friend for years and suddenly his feelings are alive. He can’t take her roommate out again as if nothing happened. Eric is determined to help Holly see herself as the amazing woman he is falling in love with, no matter the cost. Will Holly be able to see herself through Eric’s eyes and begin to heal the scars that no one else can see?

title: Masquerade Kisses: Book 2 in the Kiss Me Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: The last intern that Collin worked with nearly destroyed him . . . and his hotel. As General Manager of Hawaii International, Collin Farr cannot afford to let history repeat itself. His good name and the resort's internship program are on the line. Even though his new intern shows promise, letting her in could risk it all. Piper Allen moved to Hawaii with every intention to keep her mind fixed on her internship at Honolulu’s most exclusive resort. Determined to make a splash at the exclusive resort, she throws all of her efforts into planning the resort’s masquerade ball. Her talents do not go unnoticed, the board is thrilled with the success of the masquerade, and suddenly Collin’s heart is tuned in for her next move. A mysterious New Year's kiss brings the welcome distraction she needs to keep her growing feelings for Collin at bay and be the professional she is. Will it ruin everything when she discovers the truth of that life changing kiss?

title: Lore: A Miss-Fortunate Adventures Prequel (Balance of Fates)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: Welcome to Aearth Brave Adventurers Wanted! This collection of six short stories will introduce you to the broken world of Aearth. Glimpse moments in time. Where magic and the gods still influence the world. Step foot into the world since the loss of magic. Where monsters haunt more than nightmares. Aearth was once a place of magic and wonder. A world where the gods were said to walk among its people and gift champions with great power. Aearth, once so powerful and grand, fell to the Great War over two-thousand years ago. When the Gods created Aearth, they gave a country to each of their races. The forest of the north to the elves and fawn folk. The mountains to the dwarves and small people. The desert was given to those brave enough to survive among the monsterkin. The southern jungle was gifted to the elementals. While the plains and swamps were given to those that would live close to nature. The central plains were gifted to humanity. Humanity quickly outgrew its borders and so started the Human Expansion. A dark power promised humanity the world, and they were out to take it. When the Great War broke out, the gods saw fit to intercede. Their Chosen were Marked and given gifts no other mortal possessed along with the weapons to fight the armies of undead humanity created to fight their war. A group of heroes meant to unite and bind the world with them. A task they never completed. They failed. The world of Aearth broke. Magic broke the world apart at the seams. The gods saved their people and their world, piecing it back together. They took magic from mortals, infusing it into Aearth to hold it together. The gods left their people to survive without magic, in a world that is starved for it. Two thousand years later, the cracks in the world are widening. Magic is leaking into reality. Aearth and its stories are inspired by a private Fantasy 5e Homebrew. Lore is just the prequel to a much larger world and book saga.

title: The Last Desposyni (The Book of Souls Saga 1)
author: Wayne A. Elderkin
blurb: For seven years, the bloodline of Christ, the Desposyni, has been hunted by the Knights of Hell, Raum and Samael. Their relentless pursuit has left only one heir: Jacob Foster, an ordinary young man whose awakening to his sacred lineage triggers a surge of ancient forces long kept in silence. As Satan's design intensifies, Jacob is drawn into a conflict shaped by holy bloodlines, supernatural factions, and powers intent on tearing open the gates of Hell. When Jacob's Valdur, a divine shield forged by the archangel Michael, ignites, the Lamia Society rises. Guided by the archangel Raphael, led by the fierce Aurora, the immortal vampire Alaric James, and the steadfast Miguel, they move to protect Jacob, the Last Desposyni, before the mortal realm fractures. Across Blackstone Valley, Detective Harrison James, a witch with the rare ability to communicate with the dead and read souls, investigates the violent criminal empire of Dante Cain. His brutality has devastated families and sparked a pursuit for justice that draws others into the fight: Grace Lopez and her uncle Vito, searching for answers in her father's murder, and Sage and Scarlet Stone, seeking the man who stole their daughter's life. Their investigation uncovers a deeper truth. Dante is not simply a predator but a carefully positioned instrument within Satan's rising scheme. When both paths converge, mortals and immortals are forced into a single front. Together, they must shield Jacob and confront a darkness that threatens every realm. In a world where angels, witches, vampires, and the Knights of Hell collide, the struggle for humanity's future demands resolve, sacrifice, and the courage to face the coming fire. Experience a dark urban fantasy thriller shaped by holy bloodlines, paranormal crime, supernatural warfare, and mythic stakes. Ideal for readers of apocalyptic fantasy, angels and demons fiction, and gritty supernatural epics.

title: Learning Want (The Want Series Book 1)
author: Asher Rowan
blurb: Alex never set out to redefine himself. What he wanted, at first, was structure. Control. Spaces where desire could exist without apology and without explanation. In the quiet margins of the city, and later in rooms built on consent and trust, he begins to learn the language of power, restraint, and choice. But growth has a way of refusing containment. When one unexpected connection stops feeling accidental than inevitable, Alex finds himself pulled toward something far more complicated than attraction. Because intimacy doesn’t always stay where you put it. Sometimes it follows you into ordinary moments. Sometimes it asks for honesty before you feel ready. Learning Want is an intimate novel about desire, identity, and the quiet ways we become ourselves. Moving between solitude and connection, certainty and uncertainty, Alex must decide not what he is, but what he is willing to risk for something that feels undeniably real. A story about trust without guarantees, attraction without labels, and the quiet bravery of choosing what matters. Asher Rowan writes stories about longing, reinvention, and the quiet ways people learn to belong to themselves. Learning Want is his debut novel.

title: Rise: Psycho Bunny
author: Odysseus Saint
blurb: Luna has less than a year left to live. When she enters the video game world known as Rise, the first world she's ever truly been free to explore, she makes herself one simple promise: Do everything. While everyone else is chasing power, Luna explores forgotten ruins, uncovers impossible secrets, conquers dungeons just to become best friends with the bosses, and somehow finds herself caught in a love triangle with a legendary pirate queen and the world's most powerful witch. Every step Luna takes sends ripples through a world that was never meant to change. As her journey continues, the very system governing Rise begins adapting to her presence, and the entire world is forced to evolve. Because the greatest threat to a perfect world... might just be an autistic girl with bunny ears who laughs while fighting gods... yet hides behind her ears when strangers say hello.

title: The Kingdom We Built
author: Odysseus Saint
blurb: Some love stories burn. Some endure. And some become empires that cannot survive their own foundations. The Kingdom We Built is a lyrical epistolary novel about love, loyalty, shame, and the quiet transfer of power between three people bound by devotion and fracture. Alexander Sol is a sailor holding himself together with discipline and duty. Belladonna Snow is fire—intense, passionate, certain that love must be fought for. Helena Lily is steadiness—the quiet presence that remains when everything else shakes. What begins as a kingdom built in secrecy and hunger slowly evolves into something far more dangerous: stability. As deployment, trauma, jealousy, and unspoken alignment test their loyalty, each must confront a harder question than betrayal— Who deserves the crown when the king begins to collapse? Blending literary romance, psychological drama, military realism, and mythic Dungeons & Dragons symbolism, this novel is not about choosing between two women. It is about sovereignty. It is about shame. Because sometimes the kingdom you build reveals who you really are.

title: A Heartache for Christmas: A Steamy Second-Chance Holiday Romance
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: Claire Monroe swore she’d never go home again— not after Joey Carter shattered her heart three Christmases ago… and then started dating her best friend. But when life falls apart and the holidays come calling, she finds herself back in the last place she expected, surrounded by twinkle lights, old memories, and the man she never really got over. Joey knows he made the worst mistake of his life. Janette was a distraction—Claire had been his future. Now, seeing her again hits like a punch to the chest. He wants to fix what he broke… even if she won’t let him near her heart. A sudden winter storm traps their families together at a cozy mountain lodge, forcing old wounds to thaw. Between late-night fireside confessions, heated arguments, and the chemistry they can’t shake, Claire and Joey find themselves stepping dangerously close to what they once had. But second chances aren’t guaranteed. As snow falls and holiday magic settles in, Claire must decide if forgiveness is worth the risk… and Joey must prove he’s done running from the love he never should have lost. Full of family chaos, sharp banter, spicy open-door romance, unexpected pregnancy, and all the Christmas drama one family can handle, A Heartache for Christmas is a steamy second-chance holiday romance about finding your way back to the person who always felt like home. Perfect for fans of Kate Stewart’s The Plight Before Christmas , Meghan Quinn’s How My Neighbor Stole Christmas , Jackie Lau’s A Second Chance Road Trip for Christmas , and Gwyn McNamee’s A Very Grumpy Lumberjack Christmas . Featuring: Second-chance romance • Forced proximity • He falls first • Family drama • Holiday chaos • Cozy mountain settings • Spicy romance • Open-door scenes • Pregnancy • Old flames • Christmas romance • Happily ever after If you love your Christmas romances with messy families, laugh-out-loud banter, plenty of heat, emotional second chances, and a whole lot of chaos , welcome to Holly Ridge.

title: Silver Lace & Golden Gates: A Collection of Short Stories Across Love, Loss, Horror & Heart
author: C.K. Smith
blurb: Not every gate leads to heaven… Step through the gates, and you’ll never know what world you’ll land in. From blood-spattered horror to heart-pounding romance, from twisted thrillers to absurdly delightful tales that make you snort-laugh in public, Silver Lace & Golden Gates is a genre-blending collection that refuses to play by the rules. Penned during C.K. Smith’s academic years, these twenty stories reflect a writer honing their voice—sharpening it with every scream, swoon, and ridiculous twist. Whether you crave eerie small-town secrets, chaotic love affairs, or just a good story about a guy who maybe shouldn’t have opened that door… there’s something for every kind of reader behind these pages. It’s raw. It’s playful. It’s dark and dreamy and ridiculous all at once. And it’s 100% C.K. Smith.

title: The Final Podcast: Book 2 of the Podcast Murders
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: Perfect for fans of You by Caroline Kepnes, The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides, and dark, twist-filled psychological suspense. The chilling sequel to The Podcast Killer . Dominic Graves thought the darkness was behind him. He was wrong. When Hana's young daughter vanishes without a trace, Dominic is forced to make an impossible choice: remain the man he's fought to become... or become the man the city fears most. The microphone comes back on. Ethan Cole returns to Whispers in the Dark , using his infamous true crime podcast as both bait and weapon to hunt a kidnapper hiding in plain sight. Every anonymous caller, every whispered confession, and every hidden clue pulls him deeper into a deadly game where the line between justice and vengeance grows thinner by the hour. But someone is listening. Someone knows Ethan Cole is back. As the city closes in, the kidnapper tightens their grip, and the clock begins to run out. Dominic must decide how far he's willing to go to save an innocent child... because this time, failure isn't an option. The Final Podcast is a gripping psychological thriller filled with shocking twists, relentless suspense, morally gray justice, and a finale that will leave you questioning who the real monster is.

title: The Podcast Killer: Book 1 of the Podcast Murders
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: For fans of You by Caroline Kepnes, The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides, and The Chestnut Man by Søren Sveistrup comes a chilling psychological thriller that blurs the line between justice and obsession. “The city hides its secrets... but not from me.” A killer walks in the shadows, exposing the lies buried deep beneath the city's surface. Six women missing. One whispered call for help. And a podcast that dares to tell the truth. Welcome to Whispers in the Dark . Hosted by the mysterious Ethan Cole, this isn't your average true crime podcast. With each chilling episode, Ethan pulls listeners into a gripping investigation where corruption runs deep and no one is safe. The deeper he digs, the more dangerous the game becomes—and someone out there is playing for keeps. Do you dare to listen? Because in the dark, nothing is what it seems. And the darkest secrets? They're the ones whispered in the dark. THE PODCAST KILLER is a twist-filled psychological thriller perfect for fans of morally gray vigilantes, serial killers, true crime, and suspense that refuses to let go. Continue the story in the chilling sequel, The Final Podcast , where Ethan Cole returns to the microphone—but this time, for a reason no one will see coming. The nightmare is far from over. Available in eBook, Paperback, audiobook, and Hardcover Dust Jacket.

title: You Shouldn't Have Answered: Some Numbers Should Never Be Dialed...
author: C.K. Smith
blurb: For fans of Scream , When a Stranger Calls , The Whisper Man , and The Black Phone comes a chilling psychological horror where one phone call changes everything. A Halloween party. One harmless prank. One number that should never have answered. When brothers Jace and Theo throw an unsupervised Halloween party while their parents are away, the biggest problem they expect is a trashed house or an angry neighbor. Instead, one reckless game of prank calls reaches the wrong person. A voice that doesn't laugh. A voice that doesn't hang up. A voice that simply whispers... "I've been waiting." What begins as a joke quickly spirals into a nightmare. Friends begin disappearing. Bodies are left behind like warnings. And the house that was once filled with music and laughter becomes a prison where no one knows who's next. Because the caller isn't looking for revenge. He's looking for an apology. And he won't stop until he gets it. Fast-paced, suspenseful, and filled with relentless psychological tension, You Shouldn't Have Answered is a terrifying game of cat and mouse that will leave readers questioning every unknown number... and every voice on the other end of the line. Because some calls aren't accidents. And some numbers should never be answered.

title: Joy Ride: When a Prank Turns Deadly (Joy Ride Series Book 1)
author: C.K. Smith
blurb: For fans of Joy Ride , The Hitcher , Jeepers Creepers , and No Exit comes a relentless road horror thriller where every mile could be your last. A family road trip. One harmless game. One voice that should never have answered. When siblings Tessa, Nate, and Chase set out to repair the family they've nearly lost, they expect an uncomfortable drive filled with old memories and unresolved arguments. Instead, one careless round of Two Truths and a Lie over the CB radio attracts the attention of someone who refuses to let them go. A voice that doesn't joke. A voice that never stops listening. A voice that wants to hunt. As the miles disappear beneath their tires, the highway transforms into a deadly game of survival. Every passing truck could hide a killer. Every lonely stretch of road becomes another trap. And every decision could be their last. Because some monsters don't wait in the dark. They drive beside you. Fast-paced, brutal, and packed with relentless suspense, Joy Ride: When a Prank Turns Deadly is a psychological road horror filled with high-speed terror, shocking twists, and a relentless game of cat and mouse that will leave you gripping the edge of your seat until the final page. Continue the nightmare in Joy Ride 2: Deadly Frequencies , coming this September.

title: Romancing the CEO: A Spicy Office Romance Novel: Book 1 (Office Romance Series)
author: C.K. Smith
blurb: For fans of Ana Huang, Lauren Asher, Lucy Score, and Sylvia Day comes a steamy contemporary romance filled with irresistible chemistry, forbidden attraction, and unforgettable passion. Tropes: Age Gap • Office Romance • CEO Romance • He Falls First • Interracial Romance • Steamy & Spicy Rose thought moving to Tokyo would be the start of a new chapter. She never expected it to begin in the office of one of Japan's most powerful CEOs. Kenji Sato is brilliant, demanding, and impossible to ignore. As Rose settles into her new career at one of Tokyo's most prestigious corporations, the line between professional and personal begins to blur. Every lingering glance, every late-night meeting, and every stolen moment pulls them closer to a relationship neither of them can afford. But falling for the boss comes with consequences. Power, ambition, family expectations, and hidden secrets threaten to destroy everything they've built. As the pressure mounts, Rose must decide whether risking her career—and her heart—is worth the chance at a once-in-a-lifetime love. Filled with emotional tension, unforgettable chemistry, and heartfelt romance, Romancing the CEO is a captivating love story about trust, vulnerability, and discovering that the greatest risks often lead to the greatest rewards. Content Note : This novel contains mature themes, an age-gap romance, workplace power dynamics, and open-door romantic scenes intended for adult readers.

title: Return to Aberdeen Manor: Book 2: The Aberdeen Hauntings (The Aberdeen Hauntings Files)
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: For fans of The Haunting of Hill House by Shirley Jackson, Home Before Dark by Riley Sager, and Mexican Gothic by Silvia Moreno-Garcia comes the terrifying second installment in The Aberdeen Files. The manor never forgot. And this time... it wants blood. Justin Shawn Smith has returned to Aberdeen Manor. But he isn't alone. When Ethan's girlfriend, Celeste, is kidnapped, Ethan and Maeve are forced back to the estate they swore they would never enter again. The nightmare they survived has only grown darker, and Aberdeen Manor is waiting. Bodies begin to fall. Old horrors awaken. And something hidden deep within the manor stirs once more. As eight unsuspecting teenagers become trapped in a deadly game unfolding across the estate, survival quickly becomes impossible to predict. Every room holds another secret. Every shadow hides another threat. And every step draws Maeve closer to a truth she's spent her entire life trying to escape. Because the past isn't finished with her. As the body count rises and the line between the living and the dead begins to blur, Maeve must confront the horrifying mystery surrounding her family... before Aberdeen Manor claims another victim. Return to Aberdeen Manor is a suspense-filled gothic horror novel packed with psychological terror, shocking twists, supernatural mystery, and relentless suspense that will keep readers turning pages long into the night. Begin the nightmare with the prequel, Eric Stephenson: Bloodlines, continue through The Haunting of Aberdeen Manor and Return to Aberdeen Manor, and prepare for the epic conclusion in The End to Aberdeen Manor, coming this September.

title: Killer Dolls: Andy & Anna
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: For fans of Bride of Chucky , Child's Play , Natural Born Killers , and the infamous outlaw lovers Bonnie and Clyde comes a wildly twisted horror-comedy where true love refuses to die... even after death. Andy Stone is running from the cops. Annabella Larson is behind the wheel. Lovers. Thieves. Killers. Together they've left a trail of bodies across state lines, staying one step ahead of the law. But when a botched escape ends in a violent crash outside an abandoned toy store during a raging storm, their luck finally runs out. Or so everyone thinks. Bleeding, desperate, and out of options, Anna and Andy hide among shelves of forgotten toys. Then lightning strikes. When the storm clears, the lovers wake to discover their souls have become trapped inside two rag dolls—stitched smiles, button eyes... and absolutely no thumbs. Unfortunately for everyone else... Murder isn't something you outgrow. Armed with razor-sharp wit, dark humor, and an unhealthy devotion to each other, Anna and Andy embark on a blood-soaked rampage proving that becoming a toy doesn't make a killer harmless. It just makes them far more unpredictable. Equal parts horror, dark comedy, romance, and over-the-top carnage, Killer Dolls: Anna & Andy is a fast-paced splatter horror where love never dies... It just gets stitched back together.

title: The Ice Princess (Megan Russ Short Story Samplers)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: This fantasy installment in Megan Russ's standalone short story samplers focuses on the story of a Princess and her guardian. As with each sampler there is the focus story. The Ice Princess accompanied by a look at other work. Please remember to leave a review even if you don't like this short collection. Remember reviews help indie authors find readers.
