The Ice Princess accompanied by a look at other work. Please remember to leave a review even if you don't like this short collection. Remember reviews help indie authors find readers.

title: Wen Rising (Escaping Anasazi Book 1)
author: JB Juke
blurb: Set among the ancient Ancestral Puebloans in the American Southwest, Wen Rising is a dark historical romance about forbidden love, tribal loyalty, and the dangerous power of ancient spirits. She was promised to a warrior. But she gave her heart to the wrong man. Wen is nothing more than a farmer a man with no power, no status… and no right to love her. Aiyana is the chief’s daughter, bound by duty to marry Dasoda-Hae, the most feared warrior of the tribe. Their future is already decided. Their love is forbidden. But Wen refuses to let her go. To prove himself worthy, he makes a dangerous choice— one that pulls him into the path of something far older than love… and far more dangerous. Something that watches. Something that whispers. Something that chooses him. When Wen awakens an ancient spirit buried deep within the earth, it doesn’t just follow him. It binds itself to his soul. At first, it offers strength, power and a way to become the man Aiyana deserves. But power always demands a price. And as the darkness inside him grows, so does the line between love… and destruction. Because some loves aren’t meant to survive. And some choices don’t just destroy two hearts, they erase entire worlds. In a time long before history recorded their fall, one forbidden love will ignite the beginning of the end. This is not a love story that ends in peace. This is the one that ends everything.

title: The Home We Make: Chris & Tiffany's Story (Port Arbor Series Book 1)
author: Tegan E. Armstrong
blurb: What if going home means reopening wounds you fought to bury? What if it’s the only way to find love – and the one place you swore you never return to? Tiffany Samson escaped Port Arbor, Ohio the moment she could. But when her father’s hospitalized, she packs up the life she built – and the daughter she adores – and heads straight back to the town she vowed she’d never live in again. Moving into her childhood home was supposed to be a temporary fix. But nothing about coming home has been simple. The walls remember everything she’s tried to forget, and every shadow stirs up the jagged memories she’s spent years suppressing. Then she runs into Chris Bartkowski, the boy-next-door turned into a dangerously handsome professional hockey star, recovering from a career-threatening injury. He’s steady, kind, and unexpectedly patient. He’s also the last man Tiffany should want. He isn’t in town for the long run, and he can’t be hers. Unfortunately, he’s also impossible to resist. Chris never forgot the sharp-tongued girl with wary eyes. But the woman she’s become hits harder than any slapshot. She’s all grown up and fiercely protective of the daughter who steals his heart the instant they meet. As old memories collide with new feelings, earning her trust might be the hardest fight he’s ever faced – and the one that could change everything. For readers who love their romance tender at the core, spicy at the edges and the kind of healing that feels like coming home. Perfect for fans of Catherine Cowles, Devney Perry and Brittainy C. Cherry.

title: Her Healing Touch: Book 2 in the Love Senses: A Neurodiverse Romance Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: He can’t tolerate touch, but hers is the exception. Jason has spent his life avoiding physical contact, his extreme sensitivity making even the slightest touch unbearable. When his boss hires Hannah specifically to help him navigate his emotional and physical limitations, Jason is less than pleased. Hannah is a true jill-of-all-trades who thrives on connection and touch. Despite Jason’s cold reception, she remains determined to break through his defenses and offer him the support he needs. When Hannah is involved in a workplace accident, something shifts in Jason’s perspective. For the first time, he begins to see the possibility of a different future—and the potential for a relationship. But as his fears resurface, Jason must decide if he can overcome his anxieties and embrace a chance at love.

title: Her Dream Mafia Daddy (Winter Peak Mountain Series Book 1)
author: Scarlett Belle
blurb: She was running for her life. Fleeing an abusive ex, Daphne finds unexpected refuge in a quaint little town in the mountains of Western North Carolina. She finds herself under the protection of Eamon—the cold, ruthless head of the Irish Mafia and, inconveniently, her brother’s best friend. Eamon has spent his life protecting his town and the people in it. He’s calculating, dangerous, and used to getting what he wants. When he discovers his best friend’s little sister has landed in his town, he makes one thing clear: Daphne is his. But Daphne has learned the hard way that trusting the wrong man can cost her everything. When her past comes crashing into her new life, Eamon will stop at nothing to keep her safe.

title: Hearing His Voice: Book 5 in the Love Senses: A Neurodiverse Romance Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: In a world that’s too loud, Blythe has learned to navigate the chaos. Even with the burden of a constant ringing in her ears and moments of deafening silence, she’s thriving in her new life as an entrepreneur. Yet when an unexpected person sweeps into her life, she’s faced with challenges that push her both personally and professionally. Conner, the town’s charming mechanic, knows engines—but not his own heart. Stuck in a cycle of short-lived relationships, he’s been searching for meaning in all the wrong places. Until he finally sees Blythe. Her quiet strength flips a switch, and suddenly, everything clicks. As Blythe struggles to balance her growing business, a new relationship, and a health issue that threatens to change everything, she must decide whether opening her heart is worth the risk. Can Conner find the right words—and the right timing—to bridge the silence between them? Or will fear stall what could be the love of a lifetime?

title: The Haunting of Aberdeen Manor: Book 1: The Aberdeen Hauntings (The Aberdeen Hauntings Files)
author: C.K. Smith, Dina Ezzeddine
blurb: For fans of The Haunting of Hill House by Shirley Jackson, Home Before Dark by Riley Sager, and Mexican Gothic by Silvia Moreno-Garcia comes a chilling gothic horror where family secrets refuse to stay buried. The Aberdeen Manor estate has always been shrouded in mystery—a sprawling mansion where every hallway hides a secret and every shadow tells a story. For Maeve Adams, the estate is more than an inheritance. It's home. But when the horrifying truth about her biological father, Eric Stephenson—a sadistic serial killer—comes to light, everything she thought she knew begins to unravel. The house she once loved becomes a prison of unanswered questions, lingering nightmares, and a past determined to claw its way back into the present. Security cameras surround the property, meant to keep danger out. Instead, they capture something watching from the darkness. As unexplained events escalate and old wounds reopen, Maeve and her family are forced into a terrifying battle against the secrets hidden within Aberdeen Manor. The deeper they dig, the more they realize some horrors were never meant to be uncovered. Because some houses don't just keep secrets... They protect them. The Haunting of Aberdeen Manor is a suspense-filled gothic horror novel blending psychological terror, family tragedy, serial killers, and supernatural mystery into a story that will haunt readers long after the final page. Begin the saga with the prequel (second book), Eric Stephenson: Bloodlines , continue through The Haunting of Aberdeen Manor and Return to Aberdeen Manor (third book) , and prepare for the epic conclusion in The End to Aberdeen Manor , coming this September.

title: Golden Hour: A Shepherd's Grove Story
author: DeAnna Kaye Fields
blurb: Bellamy Bishop doesn’t expect people to stay. With her parents gone and her friends settling down, Bellamy is convinced everyone will eventually leave her. She gives her heart to her friends, her patients, and Colonel Mustard—her beloved Kia Soul—but will she believe it when Edison says he’ll stay? Mechanic Edison Cole’s world orbits his sister and her family. He has a niece and nephew he adores, a brother-in-law who is ridiculously into holidays, and a sister who raised him. Edison almost blows off the photoshoot that would lead him to Bellamy. Between family time, teasing conversations, and chaotic holidays, Bellamy begins to believe she might actually have a soft place to land with Edison. But when Bellamy’s insecurities threaten to sabotage the whole relationship, can Edison convince her that he’s not going anywhere? Golden Hour is a cozy small-town romance about found family, taking chances, and learning that sometimes love stays.

title: Getting Burnt: A Sampler Collection (Megan Russ Short Story Samplers)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: Getting Burnt is a twisted retelling of the old nursery rhyme Jack Be Nimble. This horror retelling follows the fire dancing troupe that makes a deal for luck. What happens when their luck runs out? This is a glimpse into my horror writing style. This includes a sneak peek at Shadows of the Great Basin as well as a sneak peek at Night Creature's Lair, my other two collections. title: Frequency: She Didn’t Die. She Left. (The Frequency Files Book 1)
author: Maya Reed
blurb: What if the greatest discovery in human history had already been made — and someone had decided you were never going to know? At 2:17 in the morning, investigative journalist Maya Reyes receives an encrypted message on a channel she thought was dead. A GPS coordinate in the Arizona desert. And five words. She didn’t die. She left. Two hours later she is standing at the perimeter fence of a classified facility that does not officially exist, watching the machinery of suppression run at full speed. A woman is dead inside Hangar 7. The official cause of death is cardiac arrest. The brain scan recorded in the eighteen minutes before Eleanor Voss’s heart stopped tells a different story — every region of her brain firing in perfect, sustained coherence, as though she reorganized herself around a single purpose no medical literature has a category for. What Eleanor was doing in that hangar has been buried by a program that has spent seventy years deciding the world is not ready for what she found. A physicist who spent eight years being careful while Eleanor spent three years being right. A Russian scientist in Geneva who watched the same thing happen in 1999 and has been waiting ever since for someone to ask the right questions. A list of names — researchers, scientists, people who came too close — and a body count that is not finished. Maya is about to prove them wrong. But the deeper she goes, the more certain she becomes of something she cannot yet prove. Eleanor didn’t stumble into something. She reached it deliberately. And the question that will stay with you long after the final page — long after the denials, the hearings, the mathematics that reach MIT and beyond — is the simplest one of all. Who sent those five words? Frequency is a debut thriller for readers who know the truth is always stranger than the cover story — grounded in real science, real government disclosures, and the very real question of what has been kept from us, and why. If you have been waiting for a novel that takes you seriously, this is it. Scroll up and grab your copy of Frequency today.

title: Forgotten Dusk: Forgotten Book 3
author: Skye Lynn Bailey
blurb: She was his best friend’s little sister. He was the one man she was never supposed to want. Chelsea Crawford thought she had her life figured out until the career she sacrificed everything for left her feeling empty. Quitting her job means more than walking away from a paycheck. It means being blacklisted from the fashion industry and leaving behind the future she worked so hard to build. With nowhere else to turn, Chelsea heads home to the Circle C Ranch. She tells herself she only needs a little time to figure out what comes next. What she doesn’t need is Levi James reminding her of everything she left behind. Levi has spent his entire life at the Circle C. He grew up alongside the Crawford family, learned the ranching life from them, and became Chad’s best friend. Now, as a full-time employee, every dollar he earns goes toward caring for his sick mother. The last thing Levi needs is a complication. Then Chelsea comes home. She’s no longer the little girl who followed him and Chad around the ranch. She’s a woman he can’t stop noticing, and one he knows he has no business wanting. They’ve been through it all: her childhood crush on him, years of bickering, one drunken night neither of them was prepared for, and a whole lot of avoiding each other afterward. But now the attraction between them is impossible to ignore as sparks begin to fly in more ways than one. The more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to remember why they’re supposed to stay apart. Levi knows falling for Chelsea could cost him his best friend, his place at the Circle C, and the life he’s built around taking care of his mother. Chelsea has to decide whether going home means starting over, or finally admitting that everything she’s been searching for might have been waiting for her at the Circle C all along. Some lines were meant to be crossed. And some love stories are worth risking everything for.

title: Forgotten Dawn: Forgotten Book 2
author: Skye Lynn Bailey
blurb: He ran from his nightmares. She’s running from a stalker. Neither expected to find safety in each other’s arms. Chad Crawford’s nightmares have returned. Every night, he’s back in Afghanistan, watching a missile streak across the painted dawn sky, desperately trying to save a fellow soldier, and reliving the indescribable terror of seeing his best friend walking toward him in the open. For years, the only thing that has kept the nightmares at bay is staying on the move. And Chad has been at the Circle C Ranch far too long. He always dreamed of settling down on the family ranch someday, but he’s not ready yet. So when an unexpected job opportunity takes him to Denver, he jumps at the chance. Being a bouncer at a strip club isn’t exactly what he had in mind for his next adventure, but a change of scenery might be exactly what he needs to outrun the memories haunting him. Then he meets Anna Bishop. Anna loves her job as an exotic dancer, but lately, someone has been leaving disturbing gifts on her doorstep. When her best friend asks her to be maid of honor at her wedding in Oklahoma, Anna sees it as the perfect opportunity to get away and clear her head. The last thing she expects is to spend the weekend dealing with the brooding cowboy who seems determined to get under her skin. But when Anna returns to Denver, she discovers her stalker hasn’t gone away. In fact, her absence only made things worse. Now she needs protection, and the one man she never expected to trust may be the only person capable of keeping her safe. Chad never planned on staying in Denver. Anna never planned on needing a protector. And neither of them planned on falling for each other. But when danger closes in, Chad will have to decide whether he’s ready to stop running from his past and fight for the woman who has become his future.

title: Flames Beyond The Gate (The Beyond the Gate Series)
author: Amy Kline
blurb: A fresh start was supposed to be simple. Until the past refused to stay buried. For Jean and the girls, the mountains of East Tennessee were meant to be a reset...a place to rebuild their lives and finally stop looking over their shoulders. They didn’t expect the secluded compound, or the four men who called it home. Men who don’t scare easily. Who doesn’t step back when it matters... What begins as shared space becomes something deeper than either side expected... Something real... Something worth fighting for. For the first time in forever, all of them are holding on to something dangerous. Hope. But the past doesn’t stay buried. And this time, they’re not running. And anyone who tries to hurt them will learn exactly what burns beyond the gate.

title: First Kisses: Book 4 in the Kiss Me Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: For years, hotshot veterinarian Jim has admired Debra from afar. When he scores a chance to work with her, he is shocked to discover her Chimp Sanctuary is plagued with problems. Somehow he has to enlist her help in improving the sanctuary without endangering her job. Debra's life revolves around her work as CEO of the sanctuary. Probably the reason why she is over thirty and has never been kissed. When an ambitious new vet arrives with bright ideas, she is certain he wants to take away the one thing she loves. Debra won't let his good looks and witty banter distract her from protecting her sanctuary. But when she realizes he has her best interests in mind can the rivalry become something more? Has she found a partner in work and life?

title: Eight Days Prior (The Ten Sinners)
author: J.C. Macke
blurb: Callum Maeve is gone. No goodbye. No explanation. Just silence as Callum stares at the empty driveway. With a short fuse and a clock that refuses to slow, Callum follows every lead he can find—but every answer only leaves more questions behind. A breadcrumb here. A shadow there. Like someone wants him chasing ghosts. Every ally is watching, waiting for the Costas to resurface. But if Callum is right… this was meant to be a message. Maeve Maeve refuses to break—even when she’s close to it. Trapped beneath watchful eyes and running out of time, she knows survival means staying sharp and waiting for the right moment. When a stranger steps in to help her, she realizes he may be her one chance to escape. One problem. He’s being watched, too. But Maeve knows one thing to be true— She will leave this place. Dead or alive. Relationships will be tested. Loyalties will be questioned. Limits will be pushed. Secrets will be revealed. And Callum won’t stop until Maeve is back in his arms again.

title: Echoes of Reckoning (Purgatory)
author: Ron Shaw
blurb: "Dante and C.S. Lewis, with a little bit of The Crow." — reader review. The complete Purgatory Trilogy starts here. Clay Mitchell is dead. He wasn’t ready, and he refuses to stay buried. He wakes in Purgatory with one goal: find Ava, the woman he lost, before the realm erases him. But Purgatory isn’t a waiting room. Memories are currency, time is running out, and Azrael, the cold architect of this place, is watching every move. The lost souls around him whisper about a gateway back. Some doors aren’t meant to open. Some souls were never meant to return. An emotional afterlife thriller about love, grief and the price of a second chance. For fans of The Lovely Bones, The Five People You Meet in Heaven and What Dreams May Come. All three books are out now. Start reading today.

title: The Easy Part: A Sampler Collection (Megan Russ Short Story Samplers)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: The Easy Part is a look at my Romance Writing Style. Follow the tragic tale of a man who cannot let go of his love. Would it be better to let go and move on, or let it destroy you? To be guided to something better and still refusing to see the truth, can he turn his life into something more? Please remember to leave a review even if you don't like this short collection. title: Down and Dust (Another Odd Thread in the Tapestry of America's Wild Magic)
author: A. M. McCray
blurb: John’s job became much easier when he started telling himself he probably wasn’t human anymore. John used to be Malachy Secundus Valerio de Nyuskom, a prince who only wanted to play piano, travel around, and be home for summer. Everything changed when he woke up cursed—his right arm completely transformed—and his future no longer certain. Nowadays, he's something not-quite-human doing important work as a handyman of a kind. Magic accompanies John. It loves stories, and it loves watching the way light and dark play. It's been ten years since the last time John has seen his friend Cyrus Cooper, and magic is finally telling him it's time to stop by for a visit.

title: The DoOr
author: Jim Graham
blurb: When former Marine Kyle Kelly returns to his quiet hometown in northern Michigan, he hopes for peace - not another battle. Haunted by his time in Afghanistan and struggling to find meaning after war, Kyle's life changes the moment he meets Carlie, a woman whose guarded smile hides wounds she refuses to name. Their connection is undeniable but fragile. When Kyle presses too hard for answers, Carlie disappears, leaving him broken and desperate for a second chance. That chance arrives in the most unexpected form: the DoOr - a mysterious family heirloom with the power to send its user back in time once. Long dismissed as legend, the DoOr offers Kyle a single opportunity to step into Carlie's past and change the course of her life... and his own. But tampering with time carries a price. As Kyle navigates a world he was never meant to enter, he discovers that love alone may not be enough to save someone who doesn't want to be saved - and that some wounds run deeper than even time can heal. Heartfelt, haunting, and unforgettable, The DoOr is a story of love, loss, and the lengths we go to rewrite the moments that define us.

title: Deny Everything: A Grant Hunter Thriller Book 2
author: Scott Urbach
blurb: He left the CIA behind. But when tragedy strikes, the Agency pulls him back into a deadly game of shadows and betrayal. Veteran CIA security officer Grant Hunter thought his days of espionage were over. But the mysterious explosion of a Nigerian Air Force transport plane, killing the CIA Director and his team, shatters his peace. Against his better judgement, Hunter agrees to come out of retirement for one critical mission: rebuild the Director's Protective Staff, safeguard the new boss, and finish the mission to Nigeria that his fallen comrades died trying to complete. Plunged into the volatile heart of Lagos, Hunter navigates a treacherous landscape. He distrusts the Nigerian Intelligence Agency's leadership and faces formidable external forces aiming to destabilize the government. When a shadowy operative known only as Sarkin Duhu betrays him, Hunter becomes the hunted. Outgunned, outnumbered, and out of options, Hunter wages a desperate one-man war to protect the DCI and avenge his lost teammates. Dive into this gripping spy thriller filled with high-stakes action, international intrigue, and relentless suspense. Fans of Tom Clancy, Lee Child and David McCloskey, this book is for you! Deny Everything is Book Two in the Grant Hunter Thriller series.

title: The Demon: Book #2 in the Spirit Saga
author: Brian Thompson
blurb: Death wasn't the end for Stephen. It was only the beginning of an eternal curse, fueled by unquenchable rage. Betrayed by those he loved, he awakens as a Demon with one goal: brutal, calculated revenge. But his journey will not only drag you through a world of betrayal and justice but also through the dark side of the afterlife, where ancient grudges dictate devastating new realities. Are you ready to witness the cunning unraveling of lives, meticulously orchestrated by a spirit determined to settle old scores? In this gripping narrative, you'll experience the intricate mechanics of the spirit world, where anger becomes a formidable weapon and spirits manipulate energy, possess humans, and influence minds. Follow Stephen's chilling path as he manipulates the living and the dead, using his dark abilities to achieve his twisted designs. But he is not alone in this world of vengeance and power. Along the way, he encounters characters like the compassionate Observer Frank, the ruthless Angel of Death Rebekkah, and the mischievous Trickster Nick, each with their own agendas and abilities. As Stephen manipulates the people most precious to his close allies, the lines between good and evil blur and loyalties are tested to their breaking point. But this is not just a story about revenge. It's a provocative exploration of morality, free will, and the destructive impact of unresolved grievances. Don't wait to delve into this dark, thrilling saga. Pick up your copy of "The Demon" today and enter a world where a meticulous artisan forges vengeance and a Demon's rage paves a terrifying path. If you enjoyed "The Demon," you'll also love "The Reaper" by Sarah J. Maas, another gripping tale of power, betrayal, and revenge in the supernatural world.

title: Death's Sweet Whisper (Purgatory)
author: Ron Shaw
blurb: Some whispers guide the dying. Others devour the living. Arianna was meant to shepherd souls into the Light. Instead, she finds herself alone in a fractured realm where every decision weakens the foundation beneath her feet. The Wardens question her. The balance falters. And something darker stirs within the silence. Each soul she touches leaves a fracture behind. Each whisper digs deeper—blurring the line between duty and unraveling. The Light no longer feels steady. It feels watched. As the realms begin to splinter and long-buried forces move beneath the surface, Arianna must confront a terrifying truth: The greatest threat may not be outside her. It may be what she is becoming. Death’s Sweet Whisper is the haunting conclusion to the Purgatory Trilogy—a dark fantasy of power, identity, and the fragile boundary between salvation and ruin. For readers who crave: • Psychological dark fantasy • Morally complex heroines • Expanding cosmic mythology • Endings that linger long after the final page

title: Cursed Kisses: Book 1 in the Kiss Me Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: Some people are cursed in love, but Rosie’s bad luck starts with her lips. A curse is the only way to describe her nightmarish dating streak. Her final semester at ASU is the last chance to find a man who will break her kissing curse and save her from the dead-end dating pool awaiting her in Wyoming. Tate’s always dreamed of designing a new home from his mom, one that is free of the haunting memories of his father. But wherever he goes, he wants Rosie to be with him and to end the rumors that follow her. The only obstacle- Rosie has only ever seen him as a friend. Good thing he’s up for a challenge, even if that means facing his childhood demons. Will he forever stay in the friend zone or will Rosie see the truth right in front of her?

title: Counter Accusations: A Grant Hunter Thriller - Book Three
author: Scott Urbach
blurb: When narco-terrorists strike a dive boat off the coast of Mexico, veteran CIA officer Grant Hunter's world explodes into chaos. The crew is slaughtered. The passengers kidnapped. Among them—Grant's son and his girlfriend, who unbeknownst to their captors, is the niece of the Vice President of the United States. Grant is thrust into the center of a dangerous rescue mission. With time running out and the threat of a political firestorm looming, he must track the hostages across an unforgiving landscape of cartel-controlled waters and corrupt alliances. Supported by a network of agency assets and personal contacts spanning from Langley to Mexico City and the Caribbean, Grant must stay one step ahead of the terrorists—before they realize the true value of their hostages. As the operations unfolds, each decision could mean life or death—not just for the victims, but for the entire region. And for Grant, failure isn't an option. Not this time. Written by a former CIA officer, this explosive thriller delivers gripping authenticity, relentless suspense, and deeply personal stakes. If you like gritty realism, tense rescue missions, and CIA heroes who never back down, you'll love this pulse-pounding third installment in the Grant Hunter thriller series. Pick up your copy of Counter Accusations today to experience a high-stakes thriller that doesn't let go.

title: Cooking with Chemistry: Book 3 in the Love Senses: A Neurodiverse Romance Collection
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: In this kitchen, love and ambition just might go up in flames… In the heart of Manhattan, Maple dreams of becoming a chef—but her gift for reading people’s cravings makes any ordinary kitchen the wrong fit. Landing a job at a struggling Italian restaurant feels like fate—until a run-in with the brooding sous chef, Christian, lands her at the dish sink instead of the stove. Christian has fought hard for his position, but with an envious former colleague watching his every move, he can’t afford distractions, not with his reputation on the line. But when an intriguing new dishwasher with secretive eyes and a surprising talent takes the dishwashing job, he can’t deny the heat simmering between them. And that is very distracting. When Maple’s unique skill seems like the secret ingredient that could save Christian’s restaurant, will he risk the success of his restaurant and trust the woman nobody believes in or risk losing everything by following his heart?

title: Christian America
author: Step Jones
blurb: Is America losing its foundation? Discover the raw, unfiltered history of faith, freedom, and the true intent of the Founding Fathers. Did the architects of the United States intend for it to be a secular republic, or was it built upon an unyielding bedrock of faith? In Christian America, author Step Jones delivers a captivating, no-holds-barred look at the nation's spiritual blueprint. Blending rigorous research with an engaging conversational narrative, this book bypasses dense academic jargon to confront the most pressing questions surrounding our national identity. From the personal convictions of the early settlers to modern cultural shifts that accelerated in the 1960's, Jones traces how traditional values shaped our laws, family structures, and civic life--and what happens when those foundations begin to erode. This is not just a retelling of history; it is an urgent defense of a rich spiritual legacy and a wake-up call for the future of our culture. Inside, you will explore: The faith of the founders: The real documented beliefs of the men and women who built the nation. Our Christian Heritage: How Protestant roots directly influenced early American civic morality. The great secular shift: A clear-eyed analysis of the institutional pressures that altered our cultural landscape. A path forward: Inspiring insights for every patriotic reader looking to preserve traditional American foundations. Call to Action: Perfect for history buffs, faith-based patriots, and anyone seeking clarity in today's fractured cultural conversations. Get your copy of Christian America now to rediscover the truth behind our nation's origin.

title: Chalk it up to Love: A Valentine's Day Sweet Romance
author: Jenny Rabe
blurb: He loves me . . . or he loves me not? Nothing’s coming up roses for Daisy, who’s been abandoned by everyone she’s ever loved. But when an old house becomes available, Daisy has a chance to own the flower shop of her dreams. Every rose has its thorns, though, and Daisy’s just discovered a big one: To qualify for the house, the renovation must be completed by a couple. That leaves Daisy in the lurch . . . until Forrest steps in. Forrest has his own dreams for the house. It’s spacious enough to accommodate his dad’s wheelchair, and fixing it up will give him an excuse to spend time with Daisy. Sparks fly as they soon learn they’re renovating more than rooms and walls. When Forrest’s parents decide to move to the big city he is left without an excuse to stay in town. And Daisy must face the question: he loves me or he loves me not?

title: The Cardinal Prophecy (The Cardinal Patrons)
author: JB Juke
blurb: In a high-stakes mission, the CIA joins forces with the Cardinal Patrons to uncover the identity of the mysterious employer behind Adira Briella. But when the team is unexpectedly scattered, frustration and despair set in as they struggle to reconnect and push forward. The bonds between the team members are tested like never before. As the tension rises, Conestra and Tina embark on a journey of self-discovery, unraveling the secrets of their heritage Conestra unlocks abilities she never knew she possessed. Meanwhile, Tina follows a path that leads her to ancient truths about her ancestors and her pivotal role as the savior of Chiricahua. With Ina, a powerful spirit guide, by their side, Conestra and Tina are led to a long-forgotten cave—its walls holding the wisdom of generations past. In the depths of the cave, they uncover ancient knowledge that could change everything.

title: The Cardinal Accord (The Cardinal Patrons)
author: JB Juke
blurb: As The Cardinal Patrons scramble to clear their names, the ruthless Quillion Valentine unleashes chaos in his quest to dominate the Native World. With destruction raining down across sacred lands and ancient strongholds falling one by one, the tribes of the Jaahnavee Region must forge an unprecedented alliance with the Cardinal Patrons in a desperate final stand against the Quillios. Thesis and Rochelle find solace in each other's arms – but will love be enough as they face their greatest battle yet? With enemies closing in from all sides and time running out, they must navigate treacherous territories and face challenges that will test not only their strength but their faith in each other. The stakes have never been higher as the final confrontation looms. As the world they know teeters on the edge of collapse, one question remains: can a band of outlaws unite a fractured world before everything they know and love is reduced to ashes?

title: The Cardinal Patrons
author: JB Juke
blurb: Book 1 - A strange dream leads to a parallel world where new friends must unite to survive. Their leader, Rochelle fights to keep the team alive and together as evil lurks to destroy both worlds. Is she the savior mentioned in the prophecy or is it Tina? Does Rochelle's love for Thesis stand a chance in the face of adversity? Find out in this action-packed, survival adventure. Blending ancient Native American traditions with modern life, The Cardinal Patrons weaves a tapestry of unexpected friendships, chosen family, and slow-burning romance that will captivate readers across all genres. THE STORY Rochelle, stumbles upon an impossible discovery: a hidden cave in the Arizona desert leading to Chiricahua, a mystical realm steeped in ancient Native American wisdom and power that has remained hidden from the modern world for centuries. Life in this mysterious world has turned to horror as they face Quillion Valentine, a ruthless, power-hungry dictator determined to weaponize a member of the team's unprecedented abilities, With his own deadly weapon primed for deployment, he will stop at nothing to harness their breakthrough technology to cement his dominion across both worlds. The Cardinal Patrons, brought together by fate, discover a love and friendship that holds them together. But the very fabric separating the two worlds hangs in the balance and time is running out. Will they succeed against impossible odds or will all be lost in both worlds? This unforgettable journey questions the nature of consciousness itself—and the extraordinary power that emerges when two worlds unite against a common threat. THE CARDINAL PATRONS SERIES Book 1 - The Patrons Book 2 - The Accord Book 3 - The Prophecy (coming soon) OTHER TITLES IN THE SERIES (in the works) Teaze - Betrayal Sherry & The Rylance Mystery (YA) Death at Rylance FROM THE AUTHOR This series explores themes of loss, found family, rebuilding, learning to trust, friendship, love, survival and ancient Native American traditions & rituals on the backdrop of the Southwestern United States, covering areas in Arizona & New Mexico as well as the parallel ancient Native American World. The Cardinal Patrons start out as average people, but once they come together, they become heroes. Given the right situations, any one of us could become great heroes. You'll love this story if you love these tropes: Unlikely Heroes Friends to Lovers Metaphysical Alternate Worlds Strong Female Lead Team of Heroes Human-Like AI Native American Culture Unlikely Team Slow Burn Romance Ancient Tribes Foster Family Friendship & Love Reluctant Savior Survival Hidden Treasure High Action Military Life Military Exploits Found Famliy Ancient Spirits Famliy Drama Artificial Intelligence Spiritual Smudging

title: Broken Reflections (Purgatory Book 2)
author: Ron Shaw
blurb: Clay escaped Purgatory. But Ava refuses to be left behind. While Clay wakes in another man’s body—memories fractured, identity slipping—Ava steps into the shifting labyrinth between worlds determined to find him. Mirrors no longer reflect truth. They distort it. Each step pulls Ava deeper into a realm where alliances fracture, reality bends, and Azrael’s influence spreads like rot through the Light itself. The Wardens watch. The balance trembles. What began as a desperate search becomes something far greater: a confrontation with the forces shaping life, death, and everything in between. To save Clay, Ava must become more than a survivor. She must challenge the very architecture of Purgatory. Broken Reflections is the gripping second installment in the Purgatory Trilogy—a dark fantasy of fractured identity, rising power, and the dangerous cost of love that refuses to surrender. Perfect for readers who crave: • Fierce, resilient heroines • Emotional supernatural fantasy • Expanding cosmic stakes • Stories where love defies the impossible

title: The Broken Path (Mountain Covenant)
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: The Broken Path Book Three of the Mountain Covenant Trilogy Something is wrong in the high country. The water tastes of iron. Cattle refuse the creek. A strange sickness spreads through the valleys, and fear is quick to find someone to blame. Healer Lisi Wilson has spent her life hiding the gifts passed down through her family, knowing that some truths are safer left unspoken. When wolf-born Callan Beithe arrives seeking answers, the two are drawn together by an ancient mystery buried deep beneath the Appalachian mountains. As old hatreds awaken and the land itself begins to fail, Callan and Lisi must confront a legacy of broken promises, forgotten history, and a darkness that feeds on fear. To save the mountain and the people they love, they will have to choose trust over suspicion, sacrifice over safety, and a path neither of them expected to walk. Rich in Appalachian folklore, family legacy, and enduring hope, The Broken Path is the powerful conclusion to the Mountain Covenant Trilogy.

title: Broken Hope: 5e Inspired, Epic Fantasy Adventure (Balance of Fates)
author: Megan Russ
blurb: The battle is done, but the war is far from over. Rot continues to spread within the center of the Treefolk Nation. Darkness surrounds the Monastery of the Leaf, and it is time for its young warriors to prove themselves on their own. The physical scars are healed, but the Blooded still carry the memories of that long night in the camp of the Red Claws. Nightmares and fear, plague the survivors of the gnoll hunt, but there is no time for them to relax. The sick beasts and the Red Claws were just the beginning. Shadows lengthen and the trees grow darker as a new evil slithers among the roots. Monsters roam the forest, and the Monks of the nation must stand between vicious claws and the innocent. Reed and Railen return in this epic continuation of the Balance of Fates series. Join these two young monks as they venture into the forest of the Treefolk Nation and root out the decay that has spread through the trees. With the support of their squad, they face a darkness unlike any the nation has seen in centuries. It is time for the Red Squad to rise, for heroes to emerge and lead. Aearth might be broken and without magic, but its people are not without hope. The Miss-Fortunate Adventures Saga Continues Broken Hope is book 2 of the Balance of Fates trilogy. Book 1 being Shattered Peace. This series is only the beginning of the Miss-Fortunate Adventures. Be sure to check out the Miss-Fortunate Adventures Backstories to learn more about our young heroes before destiny is thrust upon them. Dark Fantasy Horror Low Magic Found Family Action Adventure Martial Combat Fantasy Combat Language/Alcohol/Smoking 5e Inspired Fans of Dragonlance, Ravenloft, Forgotten Realms and Dark Sun will enjoy this 5e homebrew inspired story. Fans of epic fantasy like Brandon Sanderson's Mistborn and Robert Jordan's Wheel of Time may find familiar tropes and grand adventures in the Balance of Fates Series.

title: Breaking the Yokes that Bind Us
author: Brenda Angle
blurb: How to Break Free from Stagnation and Find True Peace and Blessings in Your Life. Do you feel stuck? Are you up against a wall that you can't seem to break through? Do you feel bound by yokes and heavy laden with burdens? Discover the key to breaking free from stagnation and finding true peace and blessings in your life. In this self-help book, Brenda Angle provides daily actionable steps to transform your life. Through small, subtle changes, you can make a huge difference in your approach to life's journey. Benefits: - Gain a deeper understanding of the laws of blessings and how to apply them in your life. - Learn how to yoke yourself to the Savior and find peace in His arms, no matter what challenges you face. This book will change your life by: - Empowering you to break unhealthy yokes and embrace a new, more fulfilling way of living. - Teaching you practical tools and techniques to create lasting peace and fulfillment in your life. Inside, you will find: - Insightful lessons on the power of yoking and how it can transform your life. - Daily actionable steps to help you break free from stagnation and find true peace. - Personal anecdotes and stories to inspire and motivate you on your journey. - A variety of tools and techniques to help you create more peace and joy in your life. Don't wait any longer to find true peace and blessings in your life. Purchase your copy today complete with a notes section to help you implement what you learn.

title: What Remains of Grace
author: Jennifer Hardman
blurb: She came home for her sister's funeral and found a failing bakery, a grieving teenager, a family legacy in trouble, and a slow-burn romance she never saw coming. When construction manager Jenna Hart gets the call that her sister Grace has died unexpectedly, the life she built in Atlanta shatters. It has been ten years since she fled her Florida hometown. Ten years since losing their brother fractured the family. Ten years since she left Grace carrying the weight of everything she could not face. Now Grace is gone too, and Jenna is forced back into a life that kept going without her. She returns to Tarpon Springs to find her sister’s world heartbreakingly intact: the bakery still smelling of sugar and coffee, her niece Emmie sliding into silence, and a community that remembers Jenna as the Hart sister who ran when things became hardest. Stepping into the bakery and the house on Athens Street means stepping back into grief. It also means facing what Grace left behind: a business on the brink, a house in disrepair, and a teenager who desperately wants stability and will not say it out loud. With the help of Cole Bennett, the steady and quietly observant contractor restoring the Blue Cypress Bakery, Jenna begins to rebuild both spaces. Renovation is the easy part. What Jenna does not expect is the slow burn between them, the way the rhythms of the bakery make her feel rooted again, or the way Emmie’s fierce loyalty forces her to confront who she was, who she left, and who she wants to become. When a legal threat from Grace’s ex arrives, Jenna finds herself fighting not just for a building, but for her sister’s legacy, her niece’s future, and the version of herself she thought she had buried a decade ago. What Remains of Grace blends emotional reinvention, workplace proximity, slow burn romance, and the bonds of a Gulf Coast community determined to hold its own. At its heart, it is a story about sibling loss, inherited grief, and the courage it takes to rebuild the parts of ourselves we once believed were beyond saving.

title: Deeper Roots (The Root Series Book 2)
author: Candace Nicole
blurb: For sixteen years Carter Delaine has kept a secret. He operates in the shadows of a powerful Syndicate, but his only weakness is a woman who barely knows his name. He bought her building, installed hidden cameras and manipulated the world around her just to keep her safe. Maintaining distance was his only rule. When that rule is broken Carter's enemies strike immediately. Anika Washington is snatched from her everyday life and thrown into a nightmare of isolation, brutal betrayals and psychological torture. As her captors feed her twisted truths about her own family and the man who has been stalking her, Anika realizes her entire life has been a carefully constructed illusion. She is no longer just a bystander. She is the ultimate pawn in a terrifying game of control. Deeper Roots is a psychological thriller about power, manipulation and what it costs to survive a man's obsession. When the truth is finally unearthed, the roots run deeper than anyone feared.
warnings: This novel contains dark mature themes including abuse, violence, trauma and references to sexual abuse. Reader discretion advised

title: Black Wool: A Sampler Collection
author: Megan Russ
blurb: Black Wool is a twisted retelling of the old nursery rhyme Baa Baa Black Sheep. This horror retelling follows a young sheep farmer and one horrible day in her life. What will the farm look like when the sun rises? Find out in Black Wool. This is a glimpse into my horror writing style. This includes a sneak peek at Shadows of the Great Basin as well as a sneak peek at Night Creature's Lair, my other two collections. Please remember to leave a review even if you don't like this short collection. Remember reviews help indie authors find readers. Black Wool is a twisted retelling of the old nursery rhyme Baa Baa Black Sheep. This horror retelling follows a young sheep farmer and one horrible day in her life. What will the farm look like when the sun rises? Find out in Black Wool.

title: Before he was Commodore
author: JB Killan
blurb: Before he was commodore in the U.S. Navy, before sailing for Napoleon Bonaparte and Benjamin Franklin, before he fought in the Revolutionary War and escaped from the red coat prison, Joshua Barney was a boy. And he wanted to sail. Joshua began sailing at the age of twelve and worked his way to second mate of a cargo ship by the age of fifteen. When the first mate jumps ship and his captain dies, Joshua assumes command of a leaky ship and a headstrong crew. To prove to himself, his family, and the world that he was meant to be a sailor, Joshua has to save the ship, deliver his cargo, and unite his men. Anything less would result in the end of his brief career at sea.

title: Ballad of the Emerald Bard - Opus 02: The Suite of Wolves, Poison, and Revelry
author: Dan Bonser
blurb: El’Mindeeya Do’Katal, the Emerald Bard, has sung on battlefields and in royal courts, but her music faces its greatest test when family, prophesy, and divine reckoning take the stage. Across three tales of gods and assassins, poisons and politics, Deeya races to protect the people who define her life. Every choice and every loyalty will be tested as she must fight for the bonds that hold her world together, even as each battle threatens to tear them, and her, apart.

title: The Ballad of the Emerald Bard - Opus 01: The Suite of Seduction, Lost Love, and Revenge
author: Dan Bonser
blurb: A bard’s song. A wolf’s howl. A bond forged in love and tested in blood. El’Mindeeya Do’Katal, the Emerald Bard, has sung on battlefields and in royal courts, but her music faces its greatest test when family, prophesy, and divine reckoning take the stage. Across three tales of gods and assassins, poisons and politics, Deeya races to protect the people who define her life. Every choice and every loyalty will be tested as she must fight for the bonds that hold her world together, even as each battle threatens to tear them, and her, apart.

title: Awaken
author: T.I. Queen
blurb: When thirty–something writer Clair opens a letter that should have burned away, she doesn’t just read it, she answers something on the other side. Dragged through the Veil into a realm of warring kingdoms and cruel gods, she’s labeled an anomaly and told she doesn’t belong to either world. As the barriers between realms weaken and monsters stir in the dark, Clair has to choose: stay the helpless mortal everyone expects her to be… or gamble on a dangerous bond that could change the fate of both worlds— Or destroy her first. AWAKEN is an adult dark romantasy with a meta, self-aware heroine, morally grey immortals, slow-burn tension, and a world where every letter, oath, and choice has a cost.

title: Admit Nothing: A Grant Hunter Thriller - Book 1
author: Scott Urbach
blurb: After a terrorist bomb destroys his family and his career, veteran CIA officer Grant Hunter drifts from one temporary assignment to another. When he is called to the back streets of Bangkok to investigate the death of a fellow officer, he uncovers evidence that a KGB mole has operated for decades within the highest levels of the U.S. government.

title: Alley Cat
author: Scottlyn Rae
blurb: Hazel has spent years hiding from the life that made her lethal. Once a government assassin trained to erase magic from the world, she vanished rather than become the kind of monster they demand. When Lux Dravik returns to reclaim his father's criminal empire, he finds a dancer who doesn't move like prey.

title: The Ballad of the Curse: The Labyrinth of the Damned Book One
author: T.A. Crownover
blurb: When fae warriors descend on her village, Elera offers the only thing she has left to save her sister: herself. Whisked away to a realm she never knew existed, she becomes a guest of King Haldorin, the fallen God of Death, in a kingdom cursed to vanish for ten years at a time.

title: The Blood Weave (Mountain Covenant Book 1)
author: Honey Gouge Casey
blurb: In the winter-shadowed ridges of the Appalachian Mountains, as the Civil War tears through even the most remote hollows, an ancient covenant stirs awake. Lena Birchfield has always lived between worlds: healer, midwife, and quiet keeper of the Birchfield women's secret rites.

title: Dead Girl Walking
author: Kamira Lennae
blurb: In the remains of post-World War III Portland, hope is a memory and survival is a wish. Skylar Samuels, known as Angel to the children she protects, has one rule: no adults. At nineteen, she cares for a ragtag family of orphans in the crumbling halls of a once-grand hotel.

title: The Farm
author: Devin Sanders
blurb: The Farm takes its readers on a journey of animal sounds and sights that might not always match up with each other, all for the sake of completing a good rhyme. Complete with a QR code and music notation, this story can be read or sung.

title: Forgotten Night: Forgotten Series Book 1
author: Skye Lynn Bailey
blurb: Chase Crawford is the eldest son at the Circle C. When a beautiful woman shows up on his doorstep claiming they had a one night stand and the child she is carrying is his, he has some big decisions to make.

title: For Elise
author: Odysseus Saint
blurb: A dark psychological romance about obsession, control, and the quiet ways harm becomes normalized. When Nick returns home for Christmas break, he steps back into a relationship with his sister Elise that has never been properly examined.
warnings: Incest, obsession, coercion, normalization of abuse

title: Galeborn
author: Dan Filion
blurb: Dorothy Gale went home and left something behind. Now, her granddaughter Eliza is about to discover that Oz never forgets. This is not the Oz of childhood stories. It is a living land, where forests breathe and choose who walks through them and where magic runs through the soil thick as blood. It is beautiful and dangerous and it has been holding its breath for a very long time. When a storm pulls Eliza Gale across worlds and drops her into the heart of it, Oz knows her name before she can speak it. She didn't ask for any of this. A bloodline legacy she doesn't understand. A guarded commander who keeps everyone at careful distance and is slowly, reluctantly losing the ability to keep it with her. An ancient evil that looks at her like it recognizes something Eliza herself doesn't know yet. The closer she gets to the truth of what she is, the more she understands why Oz called her and not someone else. But Oz doesn't ask. It calls. And some stories don't end. They just wait for the right person to finish them.

title: Book Club Smoky Mountain Retreat: Smoky Mountain Retreat
author: Elisa Ann Pratt
blurb: Indie author Rose M. Brate is celebrating the release of her newest thriller, and to mark the occasion, she’s invited her closest friends from an online book club to stay at her newly acquired cozy bed-and-breakfast. With the promise of good books, cozy fall sweaters, fireside lattes, and breathtaking views of the Smoky Mountains, Rose’s friends eagerly accept their invitations. Upon arrival, they soon discover there’s far more waiting for them than Rose's carefully planned itinerary. Speculation rises when the tall, handsome stranger who came to their rescue turns out to be far more than just a simple good Samaritan. Things quickly heat up when elements of Rose’s book begin creeping into their reality. As the line between fiction and truth starts to blur, her friends begin to wonder if, perhaps, they are all an interactive part of her story Within these pages, you’ll meet fictional characters inspired by real-life indie authors, woven into a tale filled with friendship, adventure, romance, mystery, suspense… and even a touch of magic. More importantly, you’ll discover some of the incredible indie authors I have grown to love on BookTok and the amazing stories that have brought us all together.

title: Awake: A Musical Fairy Tale
author: Devin Sanders
blurb: In a world full of music, magic, and mermaids, Princess Yorinda couldn’t ever seem to find the one thing everyone else had. True love. Friendzoned, dumped, or rejected by every prince in the land, Awake is a tale of patience, perseverance, and determination. Come along as Yorinda’s story meanders through a slew of other fairy tales, as she searches for what everyone else refers to as a happily ever after. Every chapter is a new fairy tale, full of music and fun. Scan the QR codes for an audio sing-along version.

title: 1113: The Vanquish
author: T. I. Queen
blurb: Emma Hayes thought her life was a loop of dead ends—until one late-night click led her into the wrong hands. Now she’s bound to a world she never agreed to enter, where contracts bite deeper than blood and escape isn’t part of the terms. What she thought was a match turns into a sentence, one she doesn’t fully understand and one that refuses to let her go. A dark, addictive descent into obsession and control, where desire corrupts, reality fractures, and every choice pulls her further from the life she thought she had.
warnings: Contains themes of psychological manipulation, captivity, morally gray characters, and intense emotional elements.
